texts.deu.28.39: Thou shalt plant and till vineyards, but shalt drink no wine, nor gather [the fruit]; for the worms shall eat it.
texts.deu.28.40: Olive-trees shalt thou have throughout all thy borders, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with oil; for thine olive-tree shall cast its fruit.
texts.deu.28.41: Sons and daughters shalt thou beget, but thou shalt not have them [to be with thee]; for they shall go into captivity.
texts.deu.28.42: All thy trees and the fruit of thy ground shall the locust possess.
texts.deu.28.43: The sojourner that is in thy midst shall rise above thee higher and higher, and thou shalt sink down lower and lower.
texts.deu.28.44: He shall lend to thee, but thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
texts.deu.28.45: And all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, until thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee.
texts.deu.28.46: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
texts.deu.28.47: Because thou servedst not Jehovah thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of everything,
texts.deu.28.48: thou shalt serve thine enemies whom Jehovah will send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of everything; and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
texts.deu.28.49: Jehovah will bring a nation against thee from afar, from the end of the earth, like as the eagle flieth, a nation whose tongue thou understandest not;
texts.deu.28.50: a nation of fierce countenance, which regardeth not the person of the old, nor is kind to the young;
texts.deu.28.51: and he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy ground, until thou be destroyed; for he shall not leave thee corn, new wine, or oil, offspring of thy kine, or increase of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
texts.deu.28.52: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and strong walls wherein thou trustedst come down, throughout all thy land; and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates in all thy land, which Jehovah thy God hath given thee.
texts.deu.28.53: And in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee, thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters whom Jehovah thy God hath given thee.
texts.deu.28.54: The eye of the man in thy midst that is tender and very luxurious shall be evil towards his brother, and the wife of his bosom, and the residue of his children which he hath left;
texts.deu.28.55: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children that he eateth, because he hath nothing left him in the siege and in the straitness wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
texts.deu.28.56: The eye of the tender and luxurious woman in thy midst who would not attempt to set the sole of her foot upon the ground from luxuriousness and from tenderness, shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and her son, and her daughter,
texts.deu.28.57: because of her afterbirth which hath come out between her feet, and her children whom she shall bear; for she shall secretly eat them for want of everything in the siege and in the straitness wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
texts.deu.28.58: If thou wilt not take heed to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, to fear this glorious and fearful name, JEHOVAH THY GOD;
texts.deu.28.59: then Jehovah will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, great and persistent plagues and evil and persistent sicknesses;
texts.deu.28.60: and he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt which thou art afraid of, and they shall cleave unto thee.
texts.deu.28.61: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, them will Jehovah bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
texts.deu.28.62: And ye shall be left a small company, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou hast not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah thy God.
texts.deu.28.63: And it shall come to pass, that as Jehovah rejoiced over you to do you good and to multiply you, so Jehovah will rejoice over you to cause you to perish, and to destroy you; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whereunto thou goest to possess it.
texts.deu.28.64: And Jehovah will scatter thee among all peoples, from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth; and thou shalt there serve other gods, whom thou hast not known, neither thou nor thy fathers, wood and stone.
texts.deu.28.65: And among these nations shalt thou have no rest, neither shall the sole of thy foot have a resting-place, and Jehovah shall give thee there a trembling heart, languishing of the eyes, and pining of the soul.
texts.deu.28.66: And thy life shall hang in suspense before thee; and thou shalt be in terror day and night and shalt be afraid of thy life.
texts.deu.28.67: In the morning thou shalt say, Would that it were even! and in the evening thou shalt say, Would that it were morning! through the fright of thy heart wherewith thou shalt be in terror, and through the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
texts.deu.28.68: And Jehovah will bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I said unto thee, Thou shalt see it again no more; and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and there shall be no man to buy [you].
texts.deu.29.1: These are the words of the covenant that Jehovah commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant that he made with them in Horeb.
texts.deu.29.2: And Moses called to all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that Jehovah did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his bondmen, and to all his land:
texts.deu.29.3: the great trials that thine eyes have seen, those great signs and wonders.
texts.deu.29.4: But Jehovah hath not given you a heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.
texts.deu.29.5: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness; your clothes are not grown old upon you, and thy sandal is not grown old upon thy foot;
texts.deu.29.6: ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink, that ye might know that I am Jehovah your God.
texts.deu.29.7: And ye came to this place; and Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us for battle, and we smote them.
texts.deu.29.8: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of the Manassites.
texts.deu.29.9: Ye shall keep then the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
texts.deu.29.10: Ye stand this day all of you before Jehovah your God: your chiefs [of] your tribes, your elders, and your officers, all the men of Israel,
texts.deu.29.11: your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, as well the hewer of thy wood as the drawer of thy water;
texts.deu.29.12: that thou mayest enter into the covenant of Jehovah thy God, and into his oath, which Jehovah thy God maketh with thee this day;
texts.deu.29.13: that he may establish thee this day for a people unto himself, and [that] he may be to thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
texts.deu.29.14: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath,
texts.deu.29.15: but with him that standeth here with us this day before Jehovah our God, and with him that is not here with us this day
texts.deu.29.16: (for ye know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the nations which ye passed;
texts.deu.29.17: and ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them);
texts.deu.29.18: lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from Jehovah our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood,
texts.deu.29.19: and it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart, to sweep away the drunken with the thirsty.
texts.deu.29.20: Jehovah will not pardon him, but the anger of Jehovah and his jealousy will then smoke against that man, and all the curse shall be upon him that is written in this book; and Jehovah will blot out his name from under the heavens;
texts.deu.29.21: and Jehovah will separate him for mischief out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that is written in this book of the law.
texts.deu.29.22: And the generation to come, your children who shall rise up after you, and the foreigner that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and its sicknesses wherewith Jehovah hath visited it,
texts.deu.29.23: [that] the whole ground thereof is brimstone and salt, [and] burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, and no grass groweth in it, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboim, which Jehovah overthrew in his anger and in his fury:
texts.deu.29.24: even all nations shall say, Why has Jehovah done thus to this land? whence the heat of this great anger?
texts.deu.29.25: And men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of Jehovah the God of their fathers, which he had made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt;
texts.deu.29.26: and they went and served other gods, and bowed down to them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not assigned to them.
texts.deu.29.27: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curse that is written in this book;
texts.deu.29.28: and Jehovah rooted them out of their land in anger, and in fury, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as [it appears] this day.
texts.deu.29.29: The hidden things belong to Jehovah our God; but the revealed ones are ours and our children's for ever, to do all the words of this law.
texts.deu.30.1: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt take them to heart among all the nations whither Jehovah thy God hath driven thee,
texts.deu.30.2: and shalt return to Jehovah thy God, and shalt hearken to his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy sons, with all thy heart and with all thy soul;
texts.deu.30.3: that then Jehovah thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will gather thee again from all the peoples whither Jehovah thy God hath scattered thee.
texts.deu.30.4: Though there were of you driven out unto the end of the heavens, from thence will Jehovah thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee;
texts.deu.30.5: and Jehovah thy God will bring thee into the land that thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
texts.deu.30.6: And Jehovah thy God will circumcise thy heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
texts.deu.30.7: And Jehovah thy God will put all these curses on thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, who have persecuted thee.
texts.deu.30.8: But thou shalt return and hearken to the voice of Jehovah, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
texts.deu.30.9: And Jehovah thy God will make thee abound in every work of thy hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, for good; for Jehovah will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers;
texts.deu.30.10: if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of Jehovah thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law; if thou turn to Jehovah thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
texts.deu.30.11: For this commandment which I command thee this day is not too wonderful for thee, neither is it far off.
texts.deu.30.12: It is not in the heavens, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to the heavens, and bring it to us, that we should hear it and do it?
texts.deu.30.13: And it is not beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it to us, that we should hear it and do it?
texts.deu.30.14: For the word is very near to thee, in thy mouth and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
texts.deu.30.15: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil,
texts.deu.30.16: in that I command thee this day to love Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his ordinances, that thou mayest live and multiply, and that Jehovah thy God may bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
texts.deu.30.17: But if thy heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and thou shalt bow down to other gods and serve them;
texts.deu.30.18: I denounce unto you this day that ye shall surely perish; ye shall not prolong your days upon the land whereunto thou passest over the Jordan to possess it.
texts.deu.30.19: I call heaven and earth to witness this day against you: life and death have I set before you, blessing and cursing: choose then life, that thou mayest live, thou and thy seed,
texts.deu.30.20: in loving Jehovah thy God, in hearkening to his voice, and in cleaving to him -- for this is thy life and the length of thy days -- that thou mayest dwell in the land which Jehovah swore unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
texts.deu.31.1: And Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel;
texts.deu.31.2: and he said unto them, I am a hundred and twenty years old this day, I can no more go out and come in; and Jehovah hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
texts.deu.31.3: Jehovah thy God, he will go over before thee, he will destroy these nations from before thee, that thou mayest take possession of them: Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as Jehovah hath said.
texts.deu.31.4: And Jehovah will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land; whom he destroyed.
texts.deu.31.5: And when Jehovah giveth them up before you, ye shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.
texts.deu.31.6: Be strong and courageous, fear them not, neither be afraid of them; for Jehovah thy God, he it is that goeth with thee; he will not leave thee, nor forsake thee.
texts.deu.31.7: And Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and courageous, for thou must go with this people into the land which Jehovah hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
texts.deu.31.8: And Jehovah, he it is that goeth before thee: he will be with thee; he will not leave thee, nor forsake thee; fear not, neither be dismayed.
texts.deu.31.9: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and to all the elders of Israel.
texts.deu.31.10: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, at the set time of the year of release, at the feast of tabernacles,
texts.deu.31.11: when all Israel cometh to appear before Jehovah thy God in the place which he will choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their ears.
texts.deu.31.12: Gather the people together, the men, and the women, and the children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Jehovah your God, and take heed to do all the words of this law;
texts.deu.31.13: and that their children who do not know it may hear it and learn, that they may fear Jehovah your God, as long as ye live in the land, whereunto ye pass over the Jordan to possess it.
texts.deu.31.14: And Jehovah said to Moses, Lo, the days are near for thee to die; call Joshua, and present yourselves at the tent of meeting, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the tent of meeting.
texts.deu.31.15: And Jehovah appeared at the tent in the pillar of cloud; and the pillar of cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.
texts.deu.31.16: And Jehovah said to Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the strange gods of the land into which they enter, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
texts.deu.31.17: And my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them, and they will say in that day, Have not these evils befallen me because my God is not in my midst?
texts.deu.31.18: And I will entirely hide my face in that day for all the evils that they have wrought, because they turned unto other gods.
texts.deu.31.19: And now, write ye this song, and teach it to the children of Israel; put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
texts.deu.31.20: For I shall bring them into the land which I swore unto their fathers, which floweth with milk and honey; and they will eat and fill themselves, and wax fat, and will turn unto other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.
texts.deu.31.21: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles have befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed; for I know their imagination which they are forming already this day, before I bring them into the land which I have sworn [unto them].
texts.deu.31.22: And Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.
texts.deu.31.23: And [Jehovah] commanded Joshua the son of Nun, and said, Be strong and courageous; for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I have sworn unto them; and I will be with thee.
texts.deu.31.24: And it came to pass, when Moses had ended writing the words of this law in a book, until their conclusion,
texts.deu.31.25: that Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, saying,
texts.deu.31.26: Take this book of the law, and put it at the side of the ark of the covenant of Jehovah your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee;
texts.deu.31.27: for I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck. Lo, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against Jehovah; and how much more after my death!
texts.deu.31.28: Gather to me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and take heaven and earth to witness against them.
texts.deu.31.29: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and will turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and mischief will befall you at the end of days; because ye do evil in the sight of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
texts.deu.31.30: And Moses spoke in the ears of the whole congregation of Israel the words of this song, until their conclusion.
texts.deu.32.1: Give ear, ye heavens, and I will speak; And hear, O earth, the words of my mouth!
texts.deu.32.2: My doctrine shall drop as rain, My speech flow down as dew, As small rain upon the tender herb, And as showers on the grass.
texts.deu.32.3: For the name of Jehovah will I proclaim: Ascribe greatness unto our God!
texts.deu.32.4: [He is] the Rock, his work is perfect, For all his ways are righteousness; A ùGod of faithfulness without deceit, Just and right is he.
texts.deu.32.5: They have dealt corruptly with him; Not his children's is their spot: -- A crooked and perverted generation!
texts.deu.32.6: Do ye thus requite Jehovah, Foolish and unwise people? Is not he thy father that hath bought thee? Hath he not made thee and established thee?
texts.deu.32.7: Remember the days of old, Consider the years of generation to generation; Ask thy father, and he will shew thee; Thine elders, and they will tell thee.
texts.deu.32.8: When the Most High assigned to the nations their inheritance, When he separated the sons of Adam, He set the bounds of the peoples According to the number of the children of Israel.
texts.deu.32.9: For Jehovah's portion is his people; Jacob the lot of his inheritance.
texts.deu.32.10: He found him in a desert land, And in the waste, howling wilderness; He compassed him about, he watched over him, He preserved him as the apple of his eye.
texts.deu.32.11: As the eagle stirreth up its nest, Hovereth over its young, Spreadeth out its wings, Taketh them, beareth them on its feathers,
texts.deu.32.12: So Jehovah alone did lead him, And no strange ùgod [was] with him.
texts.deu.32.13: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, And he ate the produce of the field; And he made him suck honey out of the crag, And oil out of the flinty rock;
texts.deu.32.14: Cream of kine, and milk of sheep, With the fat of lambs, And rams of the breed of Bashan, and he-goats, With the fat of kidneys of wheat; And thou didst drink pure wine, the blood of the grape.
texts.deu.32.15: Then Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked -- Thou art waxen fat, Thou art grown thick, And thou art covered with fatness; -- He gave up +God who made him, And lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
texts.deu.32.16: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods, With abominations did they provoke him to anger.
texts.deu.32.17: They sacrificed unto demons who are not +God; To gods whom they knew not, To new ones, who came newly up, Whom your fathers revered not.
texts.deu.32.18: Of the Rock that begot thee wast thou unmindful, And thou hast forgotten ùGod who brought thee forth.
texts.deu.32.19: And Jehovah saw it, and despised them, Because of the provoking of his sons and of his daughters.
texts.deu.32.20: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be; For they are a perverse generation, Children in whom is no faithfulness.
texts.deu.32.21: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is no ùGod; They have exasperated me with their vanities; And I will move them to jealousy with that which is not a people; With a foolish nation will I provoke them to anger.
texts.deu.32.22: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, And it shall burn into the lowest Sheol, And shall consume the earth and its produce, And set fire to the foundations of the mountains.
texts.deu.32.23: I will heap mischiefs upon them; Mine arrows will I spend against them.
texts.deu.32.24: They shall be consumed with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, And with poisonous pestilence; And the teeth of beasts will I send against them, With the poison of what crawleth in the dust.
texts.deu.32.25: From without shall the sword bereave them, and in the chambers, terror -- Both the young man and the virgin, The suckling with the man of gray hairs.
texts.deu.32.26: I would say, I will scatter, I will make the remembrance of them to cease from among men,
texts.deu.32.27: If I did not fear provocation from the enemy, Lest their adversaries should misunderstand it, Lest they should say, Our hand is high, and Jehovah has not done all this.
texts.deu.32.28: For they are a nation void of counsel, And understanding is not in them.
texts.deu.32.29: Oh that they had been wise! they would have understood this, They would have considered their latter end!
texts.deu.32.30: How could one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Were it not that their Rock had sold them, And Jehovah had delivered them up?
texts.deu.32.31: For their rock is not as our Rock: Let our enemies themselves be judges.
texts.deu.32.32: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, And of the fields of Gomorrah: Their grapes are grapes of poison, Bitter are their clusters;
texts.deu.32.33: Their wine is the poison of dragons, And the cruel venom of vipers.
texts.deu.32.34: Is not this hidden with me, Sealed up among my treasures?
texts.deu.32.35: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, For the time when their foot shall slip. For the day of their calamity is at hand, And the things that shall come upon them make haste.
texts.deu.32.36: For Jehovah will judge his people, And shall repent in favour of his servants; When he seeth that power is gone, And there is none shut up or left.
texts.deu.32.37: And he shall say, Where are their gods, Their rock in whom they trusted,
texts.deu.32.38: Who ate the fat of their sacrifices, [And] drank the wine of their drink-offering? Let them rise up and help you, That there may be a protection over you.
texts.deu.32.39: See now that I, I am HE, And there is no god with me; I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal, And there is none that delivereth out of my hand,
texts.deu.32.40: For I lift up my hand to the heavens, and say, I live for ever!
texts.deu.32.41: If I have sharpened my gleaming sword, And my hand take hold of judgment, I will render vengeance to mine adversaries, And will recompense them that hate me.
texts.deu.32.42: Mine arrows will I make drunk with blood, And my sword shall devour flesh; [I will make them drunk] with the blood of the slain and of the captives, With the head of the princes of the enemy.
texts.deu.32.43: Shout for joy, ye nations, with his people, For he avengeth the blood of his servants, And rendereth vengeance to his enemies, And maketh atonement for his land, for his people.
texts.deu.32.44: And Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Hoshea the son of Nun.
texts.deu.32.45: And when Moses had ended speaking all these words to all Israel,
texts.deu.32.46: he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words that I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to take heed to do, all the words of this law.
texts.deu.32.47: For it is no vain word for you, but it is your life, and through this word ye shall prolong your days on the land whereunto ye pass over the Jordan to possess it.
texts.deu.32.48: And Jehovah spoke to Moses that same day, saying,
texts.deu.32.49: Go up into this mountain Abarim, mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, which is opposite Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession,
texts.deu.32.50: and die on the mountain whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy peoples, as Aaron thy brother died on mount Hor, and was gathered unto his peoples;
texts.deu.32.51: because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye hallowed me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
texts.deu.32.52: For thou shalt see the land before [thee]; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
texts.deu.33.1: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
texts.deu.33.2: And he said, Jehovah came from Sinai, And rose up from Seir unto them; He shone forth from mount Paran, And he came from the myriads of the sanctuary; From his right hand [went forth] a law of fire for them.
texts.deu.33.3: Yea, he loveth the peoples, All his saints are in thy hand, And they sit down at thy feet; Each receiveth of thy words.
texts.deu.33.4: Moses commanded us a law, The inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
texts.deu.33.5: And he was king in Jeshurun, When the heads of the people And the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
texts.deu.33.6: Let Reuben live, and not die; And let his men be few.
texts.deu.33.7: And this of Judah; and he said, Hear, Jehovah, the voice of Judah, And bring him unto his people; May his hands strive for them; And be thou a help to him against his oppressors.
texts.deu.33.8: And of Levi he said, Thy Thummim and thy Urim are for thy godly one, Whom thou didst prove at Massah, With whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
texts.deu.33.9: Who said to his father and to his mother, I see him not, And he acknowledged not his brethren, And knew not his own children; For they have observed thy word, And kept thy covenant.
texts.deu.33.10: They shall teach Jacob thine ordinances, And Israel thy law: They shall put incense before thy nostrils, And whole burnt-offering upon thine altar.
texts.deu.33.11: Bless, Jehovah, his substance! And let the work of his hands please thee; Crush the loins of his adversaries, And of them that hate him, that they may never rise again!
texts.deu.33.12: Of Benjamin he said, The beloved of Jehovah, -- he shall dwell in safety by him; He will cover him all the day long, And dwell between his shoulders.
texts.deu.33.13: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of Jehovah be his land! By the precious things of the heavens, By the dew, and by the deep that lieth beneath,
texts.deu.33.14: And by the precious fruits of the sun, And by the precious things put forth by the months,
texts.deu.33.15: And by the best things of the ancient mountains, And by the precious things of the everlasting hills,
texts.deu.33.16: And by the precious things of the earth and the fulness thereof. And let the good will of him that dwelt in the bush Come upon the head of Joseph, Upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
texts.deu.33.17: His majesty is as the firstling of his ox; And his horns are as the horns of a buffalo. With them shall he push the peoples Together to the ends of the earth. These are the myriads of Ephraim, And these are the thousands of Manasseh.
texts.deu.33.18: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; And thou, Issachar, in thy tents!
texts.deu.33.19: They shall invite [the] peoples to the mountain; There they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness; For they will suck the abundance of the seas, And the hidden treasures of the sand.
texts.deu.33.20: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad! As a lion doth he dwell, and teareth the arm, even the top of the head.
texts.deu.33.21: And he provided the first part for himself, For there was reserved the portion of the lawgiver; And he came with the heads of the people; The justice of Jehovah and his judgments Hath he executed with Israel.
texts.deu.33.22: And of Dan he said, Dan is a young lion; He shall spring forth from Bashan.
texts.deu.33.23: And of Naphtali he said, Naphtali, satisfied with favour, And full of the blessing of Jehovah, Possess thou the west and the south.
texts.deu.33.24: And of Asher he said, Asher shall be blessed with sons; Let him be acceptable to his brethren, And let him dip his foot in oil.
texts.deu.33.25: Iron and brass shall be thy bolts; And thy rest as thy days.
texts.deu.33.26: There is none like unto the ùGod of Jeshurun, Who rideth upon the heavens to thy help, And in his majesty, upon the clouds.
texts.deu.33.27: [Thy] refuge is the God of old, And underneath are the eternal arms; And he shall drive out the enemy from before thee, And shall say, Destroy [them]!
texts.deu.33.28: And Israel shall dwell in safety alone, The fountain of Jacob, in a land of corn and new wine; Also his heavens shall drop down dew.
texts.deu.33.29: Happy art thou, Israel! Who is like unto thee, a people saved by Jehovah, The shield of thy help, And the sword of thine excellency? And thine enemies shall come cringing to thee; And thou shalt tread upon their high places.
texts.deu.34.1: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab to mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which is opposite Jericho. And Jehovah shewed him the whole land, Gilead to Dan,
texts.deu.34.2: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the hindmost sea,
texts.deu.34.3: and the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm-trees, to Zoar.
texts.deu.34.4: And Jehovah said unto him, This is the land that I swore unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
texts.deu.34.5: And Moses the servant of Jehovah died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of Jehovah.
texts.deu.34.6: And he buried him in the valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-Peor; and no man knows his sepulchre to this day.
texts.deu.34.7: And Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died; his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
texts.deu.34.8: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days; and the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
texts.deu.34.9: And Joshua the son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands upon him; and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.deu.34.10: And there arose no prophet since in Israel like Moses, whom Jehovah had known face to face;
texts.deu.34.11: according to all the signs and wonders that Jehovah had sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;
texts.deu.34.12: and according to all that mighty hand; and according to all the great terribleness that Moses had wrought in the sight of all Israel.

texts.deu.1.1: These [are] the words which Moses hath spoken unto all Israel, beyond the Jordan, in the wilderness, in the plain over-against Suph, between Paran and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Di-Zahab;
texts.deu.1.2: eleven days' from Horeb, the way of mount Seir, unto Kadesh-Barnea.
texts.deu.1.3: And it cometh to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month hath Moses spoken unto the sons of Israel according to all that Jehovah hath commanded him concerning them;
texts.deu.1.4: after his smiting Sihon king of the Amorite who is dwelling in Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan who is dwelling in Ashtaroth in Edrei,
texts.deu.1.5: beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, hath Moses begun to explain this law, saying:
texts.deu.1.6: `Jehovah our God hath spoken unto us in Horeb, saying, Enough to you -- of dwelling in this mount;
texts.deu.1.7: turn ye and journey for you, and enter the mount of the Amorite, and unto all its neighbouring places, in the plain, in the hill-country, and in the low country, and in the south, and in the haven of the sea, the land of the Canaanite, and of Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Phrat;
texts.deu.1.8: see, I have set before you the land; go in and possess the land which Jehovah hath sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them, and to their seed after them.
texts.deu.1.9: `And I speak unto you at that time, saying, I am not able by myself to bear you;
texts.deu.1.10: Jehovah your God hath multiplied you, and lo, ye [are] to-day as the stars of the heavens for multitude;
texts.deu.1.11: Jehovah, God of your fathers, is adding to you, as ye [are], a thousand times, and doth bless you as He hath spoken to you.
texts.deu.1.12: `How do I bear by myself your pressure, and your burden, and your strife?
texts.deu.1.13: Give for yourselves men, wise and intelligent, and known to your tribes, and I set them for your heads;
texts.deu.1.14: and ye answer me and say, Good [is] the thing which thou hast spoken -- to do.
texts.deu.1.15: `And I take the heads of your tribes, men, wise and known, and I appoint them heads over you, princes of thousands, and princes of hundreds, and princes of fifties, and princes of tens, and authorities, for your tribes.
texts.deu.1.16: And I command your judges at that time, saying, Hearkening between your brethren -- then ye have judged righteousness between a man, and his brother, and his sojourner;
texts.deu.1.17: ye do not discern faces in judgment; as the little so the great ye do hear; ye are not afraid of the face of any, for the judgment is God's, and the thing which is too hard for you, ye bring near unto me, and I have heard it;
texts.deu.1.18: and I command you, at that time, all the things which ye do.
texts.deu.1.19: `And we journey from Horeb, and go [through] all that great and fearful wilderness which ye have seen -- the way of the hill-country of the Amorite, as Jehovah our God hath commanded us, and we come in unto Kadesh-Barnea.
texts.deu.1.20: `And I say unto you, Ye have come in unto the hill-country of the Amorite, which Jehovah our God is giving to us;
texts.deu.1.21: see, Jehovah thy God hath set before thee the land; go up, possess, as Jehovah, God of thy fathers, hath spoken to thee; fear not, nor be affrighted.
texts.deu.1.22: `And ye come near unto me, all of you, and say, Let us send men before us, and they search for us the land, and they bring us back word [concerning] the way in which we go up into it, and the cities unto which we come in;
texts.deu.1.23: and the thing is good in mine eyes, and I take of you twelve men, one man for a tribe.
texts.deu.1.24: `And they turn and go up to the hill-country, and come in unto the valley of Eshcol, and spy it,
texts.deu.1.25: and they take with their hand of the fruit of the land, and bring down unto us, and bring us back word, and say, Good is the land which Jehovah our God is giving to us.
texts.deu.1.26: `And ye have not been willing to go up, and ye provoke the mouth of Jehovah your God,
texts.deu.1.27: and murmur in your tents, and say, In Jehovah's hating us He hath brought us out of the land of Egypt, to give us into the hand of the Amorite -- to destroy us;
texts.deu.1.28: whither are we going up? our brethren have melted our heart, saying, A people greater and taller than we, cities great and fenced to heaven, and also sons of Anakim -- we have seen there.
texts.deu.1.29: `And I say unto you, Be not terrified, nor be afraid of them;
texts.deu.1.30: Jehovah your God, who is going before you -- He doth fight for you, according to all that He hath done with you in Egypt before your eyes,
texts.deu.1.31: and in the wilderness, where thou hast seen that Jehovah thy God hath borne thee as a man beareth his son, in all the way which ye have gone, till your coming in unto this place.
texts.deu.1.32: `And in this thing ye are not stedfast in Jehovah your God,
texts.deu.1.33: who is going before you in the way to search out to you a place for your encamping, in fire by night, to shew you in the way in which ye go, and in a cloud by day.
texts.deu.1.34: `And Jehovah heareth the voice of your words, and is wroth, and sweareth, saying,
texts.deu.1.35: Not one of these men of this evil generation doth see the good land which I have sworn to give to your fathers,
texts.deu.1.36: save Caleb son of Jephunneh -- he doth see it, and to him I give the land on which he hath trodden, and to his sons, because that he hath been fully after Jehovah.
texts.deu.1.37: `Also with me hath Jehovah been angry for your sake, saying, Also, thou dost not go in thither;
texts.deu.1.38: Joshua son of Nun, who is standing before thee, he goeth in thither; him strengthen thou; for he doth cause Israel to inherit.
texts.deu.1.39: `And your infants, of whom ye have said, For a prey they are, and your sons who have not known to-day good and evil, they go in thither, and to them I give it, and they possess it;
texts.deu.1.40: and ye, turn for yourselves, and journey toward the wilderness, the way of the Red Sea.
texts.deu.1.41: `And ye answer and say unto me, We have sinned against Jehovah; we -- we go up, and we have fought, according to all that which Jehovah our God hath commanded us; and ye gird on each his weapons of war, and ye are ready to go up into the hill-country;
texts.deu.1.42: and Jehovah saith unto me, Say to them, Ye do not go up, nor fight, for I am not in your midst, and ye are not smitten before your enemies.
texts.deu.1.43: `And I speak unto you, and ye have not hearkened, and provoke the mouth of Jehovah, and act proudly, and go up into the hill-country;
texts.deu.1.44: and the Amorite who is dwelling in that hill-country cometh out to meet you, and they pursue you as the bees do, and smite you in Seir -- unto Hormah.
texts.deu.1.45: `And ye turn back and weep before Jehovah, and Jehovah hath not hearkened to your voice, nor hath he given ear unto you;
texts.deu.1.46: and ye dwell in Kadesh many days, according to the days which ye had dwelt.
texts.deu.2.1: `And we turn, and journey into the wilderness, the way of the Red Sea, as Jehovah hath spoken unto me, and we go round the mount of Seir many days.
texts.deu.2.3: Enough to you -- is the going round of this mount; turn for yourselves northward.
texts.deu.2.4: `And the people command thou, saying, Ye are passing over into the border of your brethren, sons of Esau, who are dwelling in Seir, and they are afraid of you; and ye have been very watchful,
texts.deu.2.5: ye do not strive with them, for I do not give to you of their land even the treading of the sole of a foot; for a possession to Esau I have given mount Seir.
texts.deu.2.6: `Food ye buy from them with money, and have eaten; and also water ye buy from them with money, and have drunk,
texts.deu.2.7: for Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee in all the work of thy hands; He hath known thy walking in this great wilderness these forty years; Jehovah thy God [is] with thee; thou hast not lacked anything.
texts.deu.2.8: `And we pass by from our brethren, sons of Esau, who are dwelling in Seir, by the way of the plain, by Elath, and by Ezion-Gaber; and we turn, and pass over the way of the wilderness of Moab;
texts.deu.2.9: and Jehovah saith unto me, Do not distress Moab, nor stir thyself up against them [in] battle, for I do not give to thee of their land [for] a possession; for to the sons of Lot I have given Ar [for] a possession.'
texts.deu.2.10: `The Emim formerly have dwelt in it, a people great, and numerous, and tall, as the Anakim;
texts.deu.2.11: Rephaim they are reckoned, they also, as the Anakim; and the Moabites call them Emim.
texts.deu.2.12: And in Seir have the Horim dwelt formerly; and the sons of Esau dispossess them, and destroy them from before them, and dwell in their stead, as Israel hath done to the land of his possession, which Jehovah hath given to them;
texts.deu.2.13: now, rise ye, and pass over for yourselves the brook Zered; and we pass over the brook Zered.
texts.deu.2.14: `And the days which we have walked from Kadesh-Barnea until that we have passed over the brook Zered, [are] thirty and eight years, till the consumption of all the generation of the men of battle from the midst of the camp, as Jehovah hath sworn to them;
texts.deu.2.15: and also the hand of Jehovah hath been against them, to destroy them from the midst of the camp, till they are consumed.
texts.deu.2.16: `And it cometh to pass, when all the men of battle have finished dying from the midst of the people,
texts.deu.2.17: that Jehovah speaketh unto me, saying,
texts.deu.2.18: Thou art passing over to-day the border of Moab, even Ar,
texts.deu.2.19: and thou hast come near over-against the sons of Ammon, thou dost not distress them, nor stir up thyself against them, for I do not give [any] of the land of the sons of Ammon to thee [for] a possession; for to the sons of Lot I have given it [for] a possession.
texts.deu.2.20: `A land of Rephaim it is reckoned, even it; Rephaim dwelt in it formerly, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim;
texts.deu.2.21: a people great, and numerous, and tall, as the Anakim, and Jehovah destroyeth them before them, and they dispossess them, and dwell in their stead,
texts.deu.2.22: as He hath done for the sons of Esau, who are dwelling in Seir, when He destroyed the Horim from before them, and they dispossess them, and dwell in their stead, unto this day.
texts.deu.2.23: `As to the Avim who are dwelling in Hazerim unto Azzah, the Caphtorim -- who are coming out from Caphtor -- have destroyed them, and dwell in their stead.
texts.deu.2.24: `Rise ye, journey and pass over the brook Arnon; see, I have given into thy hand Sihon king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land; begin to possess, and stir up thyself against him [in] battle.
texts.deu.2.25: This day I begin to put thy dread and thy fear on the face of the peoples under the whole heavens, who hear thy fame, and have trembled and been pained because of thee.
texts.deu.2.26: `And I send messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth, unto Sihon king of Heshbon, -- words of peace -- saying,
texts.deu.2.27: Let me pass over through thy land; in the several ways I go; I turn not aside -- right or left --
texts.deu.2.28: food for money thou dost sell me, and I have eaten; and water for money thou dost give to me, and I have drunk; only, let me pass over on my feet, --
texts.deu.2.29: as the sons of Esau who are dwelling in Seir, and the Moabites who are dwelling in Ar, have done to me -- till that I pass over the Jordan, unto the land which Jehovah our God is giving to us.
texts.deu.2.30: `And Sihon king of Heshbon hath not been willing to let us pass over by him, for Jehovah thy God hath hardened his spirit, and strengthened his heart, so as to give him into thy hand as at this day.
texts.deu.2.31: `And Jehovah saith unto me, See, I have begun to give before thee Sihon and his land; begin to possess -- to possess his land.
texts.deu.2.32: `And Sihon cometh out to meet us, he and all his people, to battle to Jahaz;
texts.deu.2.33: and Jehovah our God giveth him before us, and we smite him, and his sons, and all his people;
texts.deu.2.34: and we capture all his cities at that time, and devote the whole city, men, and the women, and the infants -- we have not left a remnant;
texts.deu.2.35: only, the cattle we have spoiled for ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we have captured.
texts.deu.2.36: `From Aroer, which [is] by the edge of the brook Arnon, and the city which [is] by the brook, even unto Gilead there hath not been a city which [is] too high for us; the whole hath Jehovah our God given before us.
texts.deu.2.37: `Only, unto the land of the sons of Ammon thou hast not drawn near, any part of the brook Jabbok, and cities of the hill-country, and anything which Jehovah our God hath [not] commanded.
texts.deu.3.1: `And we turn, and go up the way to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan cometh out to meet us, he and all his people, to battle, [to] Edrei.
texts.deu.3.2: `And Jehovah saith unto me, Fear him not, for into thy hand I have given him, and all his people, and his land, and thou hast done to him as thou hast done to Sihon king of the Amorite who is dwelling in Heshbon.
texts.deu.3.3: `And Jehovah our God giveth into our hands also Og king of Bashan, and all his people, and we smite him till there hath not been left to him a remnant;
texts.deu.3.4: and we capture all his cities at that time, there hath not been a city which we have not taken from them, sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
texts.deu.3.5: All these [are] cities fenced with high walls, two-leaved doors and bar, apart from cities of villages very many;
texts.deu.3.6: and we devote them, as we have done to Sihon king of Heshbon, devoting every city, men, the women, and the infants;
texts.deu.3.7: and all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we have spoiled for ourselves.
texts.deu.3.8: `And we take, at that time, the land out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorite, which is beyond the Jordan, from the brook Arnon unto mount Hermon;
texts.deu.3.9: (Sidonians call Hermon, Sirion; and the Amorites call it Senir,)
texts.deu.3.10: all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan,
texts.deu.3.11: for only Og king of Bashan had been left of the remnant of the Rephaim; lo, his bedstead [is] a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the sons of Ammon? nine cubits its length, and four cubits its breadth, by the cubit of a man.
texts.deu.3.12: `And this land we have possessed, at that time; from Aroer, which [is] by the brook Arnon, and the half of mount Gilead, and its cities, I have given to the Reubenite, and to the Gadite;
texts.deu.3.13: and the rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I have given to the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, to all that Bashan, called the land of Rephaim.
texts.deu.3.14: `Jair son of Manasseh hath taken all the region of Argob, unto the border of Geshuri, and Maachathi, and calleth them by his own name, Bashan-Havoth-Jair, unto this day.
texts.deu.3.15: And to Machir I have given Gilead.
texts.deu.3.16: `And to the Reubenite and to the Gadite I have given from Gilead even unto the brook Arnon, the middle of the valley and the border, even unto Jabbok the brook, the border of the sons of Ammon,
texts.deu.3.17: and the plain, and the Jordan, and the border, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, the salt sea, under the springs of Pisgah, at the [sun]-rising.
texts.deu.3.18: `And I command you, at that time, saying, Jehovah your God hath given to you this land to possess it; armed ye pass over before your brethren the sons of Israel, all the sons of might.
texts.deu.3.19: Only, your wives, and your infants, and your cattle -- I have known that ye have much cattle -- do dwell in your cities which I have given to you,
texts.deu.3.20: till that Jehovah give rest to your brethren like yourselves, and they also have possessed the land which Jehovah your God is giving to them beyond the Jordan, then ye have turned back each to his possession, which I have given to you.
texts.deu.3.21: `And Jehoshua I have commanded at that time, saying, Thine eyes are seeing all that which Jehovah your God hath done to these two kings -- so doth Jehovah to all the kingdoms whither thou are passing over;
texts.deu.3.22: fear them not, for Jehovah your God, He is fighting for you.
texts.deu.3.23: `And I entreat for grace unto Jehovah, at that time, saying,
texts.deu.3.24: Lord Jehovah, Thou -- Thou hast begun to shew Thy servant Thy greatness, and Thy strong hand; for who [is] a God in the heavens or in earth who doth according to Thy works, and according to Thy might?
texts.deu.3.25: Let me pass over, I pray Thee, and see the good land which [is] beyond the Jordan, this good hill-country, and Lebanon.
texts.deu.3.26: `And Jehovah sheweth himself wroth with me, for your sake, and hath not hearkened unto me, and Jehovah saith unto me, Enough for thee; add not to speak unto Me any more about this thing:
texts.deu.3.27: go up [to] the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with thine eyes -- for thou dost not pass over this Jordan;
texts.deu.3.28: and charge Jehoshua, and strengthen him, and harden him, for he doth pass over before this people, and he doth cause them to inherit the land which thou seest.
texts.deu.3.29: `And we dwell in a valley over-against Beth-Peor.
texts.deu.4.1: `And now, Israel, hearken unto the statutes, and unto the judgments which I am teaching you to do, so that ye live, and have gone in, and possessed the land which Jehovah God of your fathers is giving to you.
texts.deu.4.2: Ye do not add to the word which I am commanding you, nor diminish from it, to keep the commands of Jehovah your God which I am commanding you.
texts.deu.4.3: `Your eyes are seeing that which Jehovah hath done in Baal-Peor, for every man who hath gone after Baal-Peor, Jehovah thy God hath destroyed him from thy midst;
texts.deu.4.4: and ye who are cleaving to Jehovah your God, [are] alive, all of you, to-day.
texts.deu.4.5: `See, I have taught you statutes and judgments, as Jehovah my God hath commanded me -- to do so, in the midst of the land whither ye are going in to possess it;
texts.deu.4.6: and ye have kept and done [them] (for it [is] your wisdom and your understanding) before the eyes of the peoples who hear all these statutes, and they have said, Only, a people wise and understanding [is] this great nation.
texts.deu.4.7: `For which [is] the great nation that hath God near unto it, as Jehovah our God, in all we have called unto him?
texts.deu.4.8: and which [is] the great nation which hath righteous statutes and judgments according to all this law which I am setting before you to-day?
texts.deu.4.9: `Only, take heed to thyself, and watch thy soul exceedingly, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they turn aside from thy heart, all days of thy life; and thou hast made them known to thy sons, and to thy sons' sons.
texts.deu.4.10: `The day when thou hast stood before Jehovah thy God in Horeb -- in Jehovah's saying unto me, Assemble to Me the people, and I cause them to hear My words, so that they learn to fear Me all the days that they are alive on the ground, and their sons they teach; --
texts.deu.4.11: and ye draw near and stand under the mountain, and the mountain is burning with fire unto the heart of the heavens -- darkness, cloud, yea, thick darkness:
texts.deu.4.12: `And Jehovah speaketh unto you out of the midst of the fire; a voice of words ye are hearing and a similitude ye are not seeing, only a voice;
texts.deu.4.13: and He declareth to you His covenant, which He hath commanded you to do, the Ten Matters, and He writeth them upon two tables of stone.
texts.deu.4.14: `And me hath Jehovah commanded at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, for your doing them in the land whither ye are passing over to possess it;
texts.deu.4.15: and ye have been very watchful of your souls, for ye have not seen any similitude in the day of Jehovah's speaking unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire,
texts.deu.4.16: lest ye do corruptly, and have made to you a graven image, a similitude of any figure, a form of male or female --
texts.deu.4.17: a form of any beast which [is] in the earth -- a form of any winged bird which flieth in the heavens --
texts.deu.4.18: a form of any creeping thing on the ground -- a form of any fish which [is] in the waters under the earth;
texts.deu.4.19: `And lest thou lift up thine eyes towards the heavens, and hast seen the sun, and the moon, and the stars, all the host of the heavens, and thou hast been forced, and hast bowed thyself to them, and served them, which Jehovah thy God hath apportioned to all the peoples under the whole heavens.
texts.deu.4.20: `And you hath Jehovah taken, and He is bringing you out from the iron furnace, from Egypt, to be to Him for a people -- an inheritance, as [at] this day.
texts.deu.4.21: `And Jehovah hath shewed himself wroth with me because of your words, and sweareth to my not passing over the Jordan, and to my not going in unto the good land which Jehovah thy God is giving to thee -- an inheritance;
texts.deu.4.22: for I am dying in this land; I am not passing over the Jordan, and ye are passing over, and have possessed this good land.
texts.deu.4.23: `Take heed to yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of Jehovah your God, which He hath made with you, and have made to yourselves a graven image, a similitude of anything [concerning] which Jehovah thy God hath charged thee:
texts.deu.4.24: for Jehovah thy God is a fire consuming -- a zealous God.
texts.deu.4.25: `When thou begettest sons and sons' sons, and ye have become old in the land, and have done corruptly, and have made a graven image, a similitude of anything, and have done the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah, to provoke Him to anger: --
texts.deu.4.26: I have caused to testify against you this day the heavens and the earth, that ye do perish utterly hastily from off the land whither ye are passing over the Jordan to possess it; ye do not prolong days upon it, but are utterly destroyed;
texts.deu.4.27: and Jehovah hath scattered you among the peoples, and ye have been left few in number among the nations, whither Jehovah leadeth you,
texts.deu.4.28: and ye have served there gods, work of man's hands, wood and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
texts.deu.4.29: `And -- ye have sought from thence Jehovah thy God, and hast found, when thou seekest Him with all thy heart, and with all thy soul,
texts.deu.4.30: in distress [being] to thee, and all these things have found thee, in the latter end of the days, and thou hast turned back unto Jehovah thy God, and hast hearkened to His voice;
texts.deu.4.31: for a merciful God [is] Jehovah thy God; He doth not fail thee, nor destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers, which He hath sworn to them.
texts.deu.4.32: `For, ask, I pray thee, at the former days which have been before thee, from the day that God prepared man on the earth, and from the [one] end of the heavens even unto the [other] end of the heavens, whether there hath been as this great thing -- or hath been heard like it?
texts.deu.4.33: Hath a people heard the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, thou -- and doth live?
texts.deu.4.34: Or hath God tried to go in to take to Himself, a nation from the midst of a nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a strong hand, and by a stretched-out arm, and by great terrors -- according to all that Jehovah your God hath done to you, in Egypt, before your eyes?
texts.deu.4.35: Thou, thou hast been shewn [it], to know that Jehovah He [is] God; there is none else besides Him.
texts.deu.4.36: `From the heavens He hath caused thee to hear His voice, to instruct thee, and on earth He hath shewed thee His great fire, and His words thou hast heard out of the midst of the fire.
texts.deu.4.37: `And because that He hath loved thy fathers, He doth also fix on their seed after them, and doth bring thee out, in His presence, by His great power, from Egypt:
texts.deu.4.38: to dispossess nations greater and stronger than thou, from thy presence, to bring thee in to give to thee their land -- an inheritance, as [at] this day.
texts.deu.4.39: `And thou hast known to-day, and hast turned [it] back unto thy heart, that Jehovah He [is] God, in the heavens above, and on the earth beneath -- there is none else;
texts.deu.4.40: and thou hast kept His statutes and His commands which I am commanding thee to-day, so that it is well to thee, and to thy sons after thee, and so that thou prolongest days on the ground which Jehovah thy God is giving to thee -- all the days.'
texts.deu.4.41: Then Moses separateth three cities beyond the Jordan, towards the sun-rising,
texts.deu.4.42: for the fleeing thither of the man-slayer, who slayeth his neighbour unknowingly, and he is not hating him heretofore, and he hath fled unto one of these cities, and he hath lived:
texts.deu.4.43: Bezer, in the wilderness, in the land of the plain, of the Reubenite; and Ramoth, in Gilead, of the Gadite; and Golan, in Bashan, of the Manassahite.
texts.deu.4.44: And this [is] the law which Moses hath set before the sons of Israel;
texts.deu.4.45: these [are] the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses hath spoken unto the sons of Israel, in their coming out of Egypt,
texts.deu.4.46: beyond the Jordan, in the valley over-against Beth-Peor, in the land of Sihon, king of the Amorite, who is dwelling in Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel have smitten, in their coming out of Egypt,
texts.deu.4.47: and they possess his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorite who [are] beyond the Jordan, [towards] the sun-rising;
texts.deu.4.48: from Aroer, which [is] by the edge of the brook Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which [is] Hermon --
texts.deu.4.49: and all the plain beyond the Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
texts.deu.5.1: And Moses calleth unto all Israel, and saith unto them, `Hear, Israel, the statutes and the judgments which I am speaking in your ears to-day, and ye have learned them, and have observed to do them.
texts.deu.5.2: Jehovah our God made with us a covenant in Horeb;
texts.deu.5.3: not with our fathers hath Jehovah made this covenant, but with us; we -- these -- here to-day -- all of us alive.
texts.deu.5.4: Face to face hath Jehovah spoken with you, in the mount, out of the midst of the fire;
texts.deu.5.5: I am standing between Jehovah and you, at that time, to declare to you the word of Jehovah, for ye have been afraid from the presence of the fire, and ye have not gone up into the mount; saying:
texts.deu.5.6: `I Jehovah [am] thy God, who hath brought thee out from the land of Egypt, from a house of servants.
texts.deu.5.7: `Thou hast no other gods in My presence.
texts.deu.5.8: `Thou dost not make to thee a graven image, any similitude which [is] in the heavens above, and which [is] in the earth beneath, and which [is] in the waters under the earth;
texts.deu.5.9: thou dost not bow thyself to them nor serve them, for I Jehovah thy God [am] a zealous God, charging iniquity of fathers on children, and on a third [generation], and on a fourth, to those hating Me;
texts.deu.5.10: and doing kindness to thousands, to those loving Me, and to those keeping My commands.
texts.deu.5.11: `Thou dost not take up the Name of Jehovah thy God for a vain thing, for Jehovah doth not acquit him who taketh up His Name for a vain thing.
texts.deu.5.12: `Observe the day of the sabbath -- to sanctify it, as Jehovah thy God hath commanded thee;
texts.deu.5.13: six days thou dost labour, and hast done all thy work,
texts.deu.5.14: and the seventh day [is] a sabbath to Jehovah thy God; thou dost not do any work, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy handmaid, and thine ox, and thine ass, and all thy cattle, and thy sojourner who [is] within thy gates; so that thy man-servant, and thy handmaid doth rest like thyself;
texts.deu.5.15: and thou hast remembered that a servant thou hast been in the land of Egypt, and Jehovah thy God is bringing thee out thence by a strong hand, and by a stretched-out arm; therefore hath Jehovah thy God commanded thee to keep the day of the sabbath.
texts.deu.5.16: `Honour thy father and thy mother, as Jehovah thy God hath commanded thee, so that thy days are prolonged, and so that it is well with thee, on the ground which Jehovah thy God is giving to thee.
texts.deu.5.20: `Thou dost not answer against thy neighbour -- a false testimony.
texts.deu.5.21: `Thou dost not desire thy neighbour's wife; nor dost thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, and his man-servant, and his handmaid, his ox, and his ass, and anything which [is] thy neighbour's.
texts.deu.5.22: `These words hath Jehovah spoken unto all your assembly, in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness -- a great voice; and He hath not added, and He writeth them on two tables of stone, and giveth them unto me.
texts.deu.5.23: `And it cometh to pass as ye hear the voice out of the midst of the darkness, and of the mountain burning with fire, that ye come near unto me, all the heads of your tribes, and your elders,
texts.deu.5.24: and say, Lo, Jehovah our God hath shewed us His honour, and His greatness; and His voice we have heard out of the midst of the fire; this day we have seen that God doth speak with man -- and he hath lived.
texts.deu.5.25: `And, now, why do we die? for consume us doth this great fire -- if we add to hear the voice of Jehovah our God any more -- then we have died.
texts.deu.5.26: For who of all flesh [is] he who hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire like us -- and doth live?
texts.deu.5.27: Draw near thou, and hear all that which Jehovah our God saith, and thou, thou dost speak unto us all that which Jehovah our God speaketh unto thee, and we have hearkened, and done it.
texts.deu.5.28: `And Jehovah heareth the voice of your words, in your speaking unto me, and Jehovah saith unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken unto thee; they have done well [in] all that they have spoken.
texts.deu.5.29: O that their heart had been thus to them, to fear Me, and to keep My commands all the days, that it may be well with them, and with their sons -- to the age!
texts.deu.5.30: `Go, say to them, Turn back for yourselves, to your tents;
texts.deu.5.31: and thou here stand thou with Me, and let Me speak unto thee all the command, and the statutes, and the judgments which thou dost teach them, and they have done in the land which I am giving to them to possess it.
texts.deu.5.32: `And ye have observed to do as Jehovah your God hath commanded you, ye turn not aside -- right or left;
texts.deu.5.33: in all the way which Jehovah your God hath commanded you ye walk, so that ye live, and [it is] well with you, and ye have prolonged days in the land which ye possess.
texts.deu.6.1: `And this [is] the command, the statutes and the judgments which Jehovah your God hath commanded to teach you, to do in the land which ye are passing over thither to possess it,
texts.deu.6.2: so that thou dost fear Jehovah thy God, to keep all His statutes and His commands, which I am commanding thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all days of thy life, and so that thy days are prolonged.
texts.deu.6.3: `And thou hast heard, O Israel, and observed to do, that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest multiply exceedingly, as Jehovah, God of thy fathers, hath spoken to thee, [in] the land flowing with milk and honey.
texts.deu.6.4: `Hear, O Israel, Jehovah our God [is] one Jehovah;
texts.deu.6.5: and thou hast loved Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might,
texts.deu.6.6: and these words which I am commanding thee to-day have been on thine heart,
texts.deu.6.7: and thou hast repeated them to thy sons, and spoken of them in thy sitting in thine house, and in thy walking in the way, and in thy lying down, and in thy rising up,
texts.deu.6.8: and hast bound them for a sign upon thy hand, and they have been for frontlets between thine eyes,
texts.deu.6.9: and thou hast written them on door-posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
texts.deu.6.10: `And it hath been, when Jehovah thy God doth bring thee in unto the land which He hath sworn to thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to thee -- cities great and good, which thou hast not built,
texts.deu.6.11: and houses full of all good things which thou hast not filled, and wells digged which thou hast not digged, vineyards and olive-yards which thou hast not planted, and thou hast eaten, and been satisfied;
texts.deu.6.12: `Take heed to thyself lest thou forget Jehovah who hath brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of a house of servants;
texts.deu.6.13: Jehovah thy God thou dost fear, and Him thou dost serve, and by His name thou dost swear;
texts.deu.6.14: ye do not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who [are] round about you;
texts.deu.6.15: for a zealous God [is] Jehovah thy God in thy midst -- lest the anger of Jehovah thy God burn against thee, and He hath destroyed thee from off the face of the ground.
texts.deu.6.16: `Ye do not try Jehovah your God as ye tried in Massah;
texts.deu.6.17: ye do diligently keep the commands of Jehovah your God, and His testimonies, and His statutes which He hath commanded thee,
texts.deu.6.18: and thou hast done that which is right and good in the eyes of Jehovah, so that it is well with thee, and thou hast gone in and possessed the good land which Jehovah hath sworn to thy fathers,
texts.deu.6.19: to drive away all thine enemies from thy presence, as Jehovah hath spoken.
texts.deu.6.20: `When thy son asketh thee hereafter, saying, What [are] the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Jehovah our God hath commanded you?
texts.deu.6.21: then thou hast said to thy son, Servants we have been to Pharaoh in Egypt, and Jehovah bringeth us out of Egypt by a high hand;
texts.deu.6.22: and Jehovah giveth signs and wonders, great and sad, on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
texts.deu.6.23: and us He hath brought out thence, in order to bring us in, to give to us the land which He had sworn to our fathers.
texts.deu.6.24: And Jehovah commandeth us to do all these statutes, to fear Jehovah our God, for good to ourselves all the days, to keep us alive, as [at] this day;
texts.deu.6.25: and righteousness it is for us, when we observe to do all this command before Jehovah our God, as He hath commanded us.
texts.deu.7.1: `When Jehovah thy God doth bring thee in unto the land whither thou art going in to possess it, and He hath cast out many nations from thy presence, the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations more numerous and mighty than thou,
texts.deu.7.2: and Jehovah thy God hath given them before thee, and thou hast smitten them -- thou dost utterly devote them -- thou dost not make with them a covenant, nor dost thou favour them.
texts.deu.7.3: `And thou dost not join in marriage with them; thy daughter thou dost not give to his son, and his daughter thou dost not take to thy son,
texts.deu.7.4: for he doth turn aside thy son from after Me, and they have served other gods, and the anger of Jehovah hath burned against you, and hath destroyed thee hastily.
texts.deu.7.5: `But thus thou dost to them: their altars ye break down, and their standing pillars ye shiver, and their shrines ye cut down, and their graven images ye burn with fire;
texts.deu.7.6: for a holy people [art] thou to Jehovah thy God; on thee hath Jehovah thy God fixed, to be to Him for a peculiar people, out of all the peoples who [are] on the face of the ground.
texts.deu.7.7: `Not because of your being more numerous than any of the peoples hath Jehovah delighted in you, and fixeth on you, for ye [are] the least of all the peoples,
texts.deu.7.8: but because of Jehovah's loving you, and because of His keeping the oath which He hath sworn to your fathers, hath Jehovah brought you out by a strong hand, and doth ransom you from a house of servants, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
texts.deu.7.9: `And thou hast known that Jehovah thy God He [is] God, the faithful God, keeping the covenant, and the kindness, to those loving Him, and to those keeping His commands -- to a thousand generations,
texts.deu.7.10: and repaying to those hating Him, unto their face, to destroy them; He delayeth not to him who is hating Him -- unto his face, He repayeth to him --
texts.deu.7.11: and thou hast kept the command, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I am commanding thee to-day to do them.
texts.deu.7.12: `And it hath been, because ye hear these judgments, and have kept, and done them, that Jehovah thy God hath kept to thee the covenant and the kindness which He hath sworn to thy fathers,
texts.deu.7.13: and hath loved thee, and blessed thee, and multiplied thee, and hath blessed the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy ground, thy corn, and thy new wine, and thine oil, the increase of thine oxen, and the wealth of thy flock, on the ground which He hath sworn to thy fathers to give to thee.
texts.deu.7.14: `Blessed art thou above all the peoples, there is not in thee a barren man or a barren woman -- nor among your cattle;
texts.deu.7.15: and Jehovah hath turned aside from thee every sickness, and none of the evil diseases of Egypt (which thou hast known) doth He put on thee, and He hath put them on all hating thee.
texts.deu.7.16: `And thou hast consumed all the peoples whom Jehovah thy God is giving to thee; thine eye hath no pity on them, and thou dost not serve their gods, for a snare it [is] to thee.
texts.deu.7.17: `When thou sayest in thine heart, These nations [are] more numerous than I, how am I able to dispossess them? --
texts.deu.7.18: thou art not afraid of them; thou dost surely remember that which Jehovah thy God hath done to Pharaoh, and to all Egypt,
texts.deu.7.19: the great trials which thine eyes have seen, and the signs, and the wonders, and the strong hand, and the stretched-out arm, with which Jehovah thy God hath brought thee out; so doth Jehovah thy God to all the peoples of whose presence thou art afraid.
texts.deu.7.20: `And also the locust doth Jehovah thy God send among them, till the destruction of those who are left, and of those who are hidden from thy presence;
texts.deu.7.21: thou art not terrified by their presence, for Jehovah thy God [is] in thy midst, a God great and fearful.
texts.deu.7.22: `And Jehovah thy God hath cast out these nations from thy presence little [by] little, (thou art not able to consume them hastily, lest the beast of the field multiply against thee),
texts.deu.7.23: and Jehovah thy God hath given them before thee, and destroyed them -- a great destruction -- till their destruction;
texts.deu.7.24: and He hath given their kings into thy hand, and thou hast destroyed their name from under the heavens; no man doth station himself in thy presence till thou hast destroyed them.
texts.deu.7.25: `The graven images of their gods ye do burn with fire; thou dost not desire the silver and gold on them, nor hast thou taken [it] to thyself, lest thou be snared by it, for the abomination of Jehovah thy God it [is];
texts.deu.7.26: and thou dost not bring in an abomination unto thy house -- or thou hast been devoted like it; -- thou dost utterly detest it, and thou dost utterly abominate it; for it [is] devoted.
texts.deu.8.1: `All the command which I am commanding thee to-day ye observe to do, so that ye live, and have multiplied, and gone in, and possessed the land which Jehovah hath sworn to your fathers;
texts.deu.8.2: and thou hast remembered all the way which Jehovah thy God hath caused thee to go these forty years in the wilderness, in order to humble thee to try thee, to know that which [is] in thy heart, whether thou dost keep His commands or not.
texts.deu.8.3: `And He doth humble thee, and cause thee to hunger and doth cause thee to eat the manna (which thou hast not known, even thy fathers have not known), in order to cause thee to know that not by bread alone doth man live, but by every produce of the mouth of Jehovah man doth live.
texts.deu.8.4: `Thy raiment hath not worn out from off thee, and thy foot hath not swelled these forty years,
texts.deu.8.5: and thou hast known, with thy heart, that as a man chastiseth his son Jehovah thy God is chastising thee,
texts.deu.8.6: and thou hast kept the commands of Jehovah thy God, to walk in His ways, and to fear Him.
texts.deu.8.7: `For Jehovah thy God is bringing thee in unto a good land, a land of brooks of waters, of fountains, and of depths coming out in valley and in mountain:
texts.deu.8.8: a land of wheat, and barley, and vine, and fig, and pomegranate; a land of oil olive and honey;
texts.deu.8.9: a land in which without scarcity thou dost eat bread, thou dost not lack anything in it; a land whose stones [are] iron, and out of its mountains thou dost dig brass;
texts.deu.8.10: and thou hast eaten, and been satisfied, and hast blessed Jehovah thy God, on the good land which he hath given to thee.
texts.deu.8.11: `Take heed to thyself, lest thou forget Jehovah thy God so as not to keep His commands, and His judgments, and His statutes which I am commanding thee to-day;
texts.deu.8.12: lest thou eat, and hast been satisfied, and good houses dost build, and hast inhabited;
texts.deu.8.13: and thy herd and thy flock be multiplied, and silver and gold be multiplied to thee; and all that is thine be multiplied:
texts.deu.8.14: `And thy heart hath been high, and thou hast forgotten Jehovah thy God (who is bringing thee out of the land of Egypt, out of a house of servants;
texts.deu.8.15: who is causing thee to go in the great and the terrible wilderness -- burning serpent, and scorpion, and thirst -- where there is no water; who is bringing out to thee waters from the flinty rock;
texts.deu.8.16: who is causing thee to eat manna in the wilderness, which thy fathers have not known, in order to humble thee, and in order to try thee, to do thee good in thy latter end),
texts.deu.8.17: and thou hast said in thy heart, My power, and the might of my hand, hath made for me this wealth:
texts.deu.8.18: `And thou hast remembered Jehovah thy God, for He it [is] who is giving to thee power to make wealth, in order to establish His covenant which He hath sworn to thy fathers as [at] this day.
texts.deu.8.19: `And it hath been -- if thou really forget Jehovah thy God, and hast gone after other gods, and served them, and bowed thyself to them, I have testified against you to-day that ye do utterly perish;
texts.deu.8.20: as the nations whom Jehovah is destroying from your presence, so ye perish; because ye hearken not to the voice of Jehovah your God.
texts.deu.9.1: `Hear, Israel, thou art passing over to-day the Jordan, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself; cities great and fenced in the heavens;
texts.deu.9.2: a people great and tall, sons of Anakim, whom thou -- thou hast known, (and thou -- thou hast heard: Who doth station himself before sons of Anak?)
texts.deu.9.3: and thou hast known to-day, that Jehovah thy God [is] He who is passing over before thee -- a fire consuming; He doth destroy them, and He doth humble them before thee, and thou hast dispossessed them, and destroyed them hastily, as Jehovah hath spoken to thee.
texts.deu.9.4: `Thou dost not speak in thy heart (in Jehovah thy God's driving them away from before thee), saying, For my righteousness hath Jehovah brought me in to possess this land, seeing for the wickedness of these nations is Jehovah dispossessing them from thy presence;
texts.deu.9.5: not for thy righteousness, and for the uprightness of thy heart, art thou going in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations is Jehovah thy God dispossessing them from before thee; and in order to establish the word which Jehovah hath sworn to thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob;
texts.deu.9.6: and thou hast known, that not for thy righteousness is Jehovah thy God giving to thee this good land to possess it, for a people stiff of neck thou [art].
texts.deu.9.7: `Remember -- do not forget -- that [with] which thou hast made Jehovah thy God wroth in the wilderness; even from the day that thou hast come out of the land of Egypt till your coming in unto this place rebels ye have been with Jehovah;
texts.deu.9.8: even in Horeb ye have made Jehovah wroth, and Jehovah sheweth Himself angry against you -- to destroy you.
texts.deu.9.9: `In my going up into the mount to receive the tables of stone (tables of the covenant which Jehovah hath made with you), and I abide in the mount forty days and forty nights; bread I have not eaten, and water I have not drunk;
texts.deu.9.10: and Jehovah giveth unto me the two tables of stone written with the finger of God, and on them according to all the words which Jehovah hath spoken with you in the mount, out of the midst of the fire, in the day of the assembly.
texts.deu.9.11: `And it cometh to pass, at the end of forty days and forty nights, Jehovah hath given unto me the two tables of stone -- tables of the covenant,
texts.deu.9.12: and Jehovah saith unto me, Rise, go down, hasten from this, for thy people hath done corruptly, whom thou hast brought out of Egypt; they have turned aside hastily out of the way which I have commanded them -- they have made to themselves a molten thing!
texts.deu.9.13: `And Jehovah speaketh unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and lo, a people stiff of neck it [is];
