texts.deu.30.10: Cuando oyeres la voz de Jehová tu Dios para guardar sus mandamientos y sus estatutos escritos en este libro de la ley, cuando te convirtieres a Jehová tu Dios con todo tu corazón, y con toda tu alma.
texts.deu.30.11: Porque este mandamiento que yo te mando hoy no te es encubierto, ni está lejos.
texts.deu.30.12: No está en el cielo, para que digas: ¿Quién nos subirá al cielo, y tomárnoslo ha, y recitárnoslo ha para que le cumplamos?
texts.deu.30.13: Ni está de la otra parte de la mar, para que digas: ¿Quién nos pasará la mar para que nos lo tome, y nos lo recite, para que lo cumplamos?
texts.deu.30.14: Porque muy cerca de ti está el negocio, en tu boca y en tu corazón para que lo hagas.
texts.deu.30.15: ¶ Mira, yo he puesto delante de ti hoy la vida y el bien, la muerte y el mal:
texts.deu.30.16: Porque yo te mando hoy que ames a Jehová tu Dios: que andes en sus caminos y guardes sus mandamientos y sus estatutos, y sus derechos, porque vivas y seas multiplicado, y Jehová tu Dios te bendiga en la tierra a la cual entras para heredarla.
texts.deu.30.17: Mas si tu corazón se apartare, y no oyeres, y fueres impelido, y te inclinares a dioses ajenos, y les sirvieres;
texts.deu.30.18: Yo os protesto hoy que pereciendo pereceréis: no tendréis luengos días sobre la tierra, para ir a la cual pasas el Jordán, para que la heredes.
texts.deu.30.19: A los cielos y a la tierra llamo por testigos hoy contra vosotros, que os he puesto delante la vida y la muerte, la bendición y la maldición: escoge pues la vida, porque vivas tú y tu simiente:
texts.deu.30.20: Que ames a Jehová tu Dios: Que oigas su voz y te allegues a él: porque él es tu vida, y la longura de tus días: porque habites sobre la tierra que juró Jehová a tus padres Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob, que les había de dar.
texts.deu.31.1: Y fue Moisés, y habló estas palabras a todo Israel,
texts.deu.31.2: Y díjoles: De edad de ciento y veinte años soy hoy, no puedo más salir ni entrar: allende de esto Jehová me ha dicho: No pasarás este Jordán.
texts.deu.31.3: Jehová tu Dios él pasa delante de ti, él destruirá estas gentes delante de tu faz, y heredarlas has: Josué, él pasa delante de ti, como Jehová ha dicho.
texts.deu.31.4: Y hará Jehová con ellos como hizo con Sejón, y con Og reyes de los Amorreos, y con su tierra, que los destruyó.
texts.deu.31.5: Y darlos ha Jehová delante de vosotros, y haréis con ellos conforme a todo lo que os he mandado.
texts.deu.31.6: Esforzáos y confortáos; no temáis ni hayáis miedo de ellos que Jehová tu Dios es el que va contigo: no te dejará, ni te desamparará.
texts.deu.31.7: Y llamó Moisés a Josué, y díjole en ojos de todo Israel: Esfuérzate y confórtate: porque tu entrarás con este pueblo a la tierra que juró Jehová a sus padres, que les había de dar, y tú se la harás heredar.
texts.deu.31.8: Y Jehová es el que va delante de ti, él será contigo, no te dejará, ni te desamparará: no temas, ni te espantes.
texts.deu.31.9: ¶ Y escribió Moisés esta ley, y dióla a los sacerdotes hijos de Leví, que llevaban el arca del concierto de Jehová, y a todos los ancianos de Israel.
texts.deu.31.10: Y mandóles Moisés, diciendo: Al cabo del séptimo año en el tiempo del año de la remisión, en la fiesta de las cabañas,
texts.deu.31.11: Cuando viniere todo Israel a presentarse delante de Jehová tu Dios en el lugar que él escogiere, leerás esta ley delante de todo Israel en sus orejas.
texts.deu.31.12: Harás congregar el pueblo, varones y mujeres y niños, y tus extranjeros que estuvieren en tus ciudades, para que oigan y aprendan, y teman a Jehová vuestro Dios, y guarden para hacer todas las palabras de esta ley;
texts.deu.31.13: Y sus hijos, que no supieron, oigan, y aprendan a temer a Jehová vuestro Dios todos los días que viviereis sobre la tierra, para ir a la cual pasáis el Jordán para heredarla.
texts.deu.31.14: ¶ Y Jehová dijo a Moisés: He aquí, tus días son ya llegados para que mueras: llama a Josué, y esperád en el tabernáculo del testimonio, y mandarle he. Y fue Moisés y Josué, y esperaron en el tabernáculo del testimonio.
texts.deu.31.15: Y aparecióse Jehová en el tabernáculo, en la columna de nube, y la columna de nube se puso sobre la puerta del tabernáculo.
texts.deu.31.16: Y Jehová dijo a Moisés: He aquí, tú duermes con tus padres, y este pueblo se levantará, y fornicará tras los dioses ajenos de la tierra adonde va, en medio de ella, y dejarme ha, y anulará mi concierto que yo he concertado con él.
texts.deu.31.17: Y mi furor se encenderá contra él en el mismo día, y yo los dejaré y esconderé de ellos mi rostro, y serán consumidos; y hallarlo han muchos males y angustias, y dirá en aquel día, ¿No me han hallado estos males, porque no está mi Dios en medio de mi?
texts.deu.31.18: Empero yo escondiendo esconderé mi rostro en aquel día, por todo el mal que él habrá hecho, por haberse vuelto a dioses ajenos.
texts.deu.31.19: ¶ Y ahora escribíos esta canción, y enséñala a los hijos de Israel: pónla en la boca de ellos, para que esta canción me sea por testigo contra los hijos de Israel.
texts.deu.31.20: Porque yo lo meteré en la tierra que juré a sus padres, la cual corre leche y miel: y comerá y hartarse ha, y engordarse ha: y volverse ha a dioses ajenos, y servirles han: y enojarme han, y anularán mi concierto.
texts.deu.31.21: Y será, que cuando le vinieren muchos males y angustias, entonces esta canción responderá en su cara por testigo, que no será olvidada de la boca de su simiente: porque yo conozco su ingenio, y lo que hace hoy antes que yo lo meta a la tierra que juré.
texts.deu.31.22: Y Moisés escribió esta canción aquel día, y enseñóla a los hijos de Israel.
texts.deu.31.23: Y mandó a Josué hijo de Nun, y dijo: Esfuérzate, y confórtate, que tú meterás los hijos de Israel en la tierra que yo les juré, y yo seré contigo.
texts.deu.31.24: Y como acabó Moisés de escribir las palabras de esta ley en el libro, hasta que fueron acabadas,
texts.deu.31.25: Moisés mandó a los Levitas que llevaban el arca del concierto de Jehová, diciendo:
texts.deu.31.26: Tomád este libro de la ley, y ponédlo al lado del arca del concierto de Jehová vuestro Dios, y esté allí por testigo contra ti.
texts.deu.31.27: Porque yo conozco tu rebelión, y tu cerviz dura: he aquí, que aun viviendo yo hoy con vosotros sois rebeldes a Jehová, y ¿cuánto más después que yo fuere muerto?
texts.deu.31.28: ¶ Congregád a mí todos los ancianos de vuestras tribus, y a vuestros alcaldes, y hablaré en sus orejas estas palabras: y llamaré por testigos contra ellos los cielos y la tierra.
texts.deu.31.29: Porque yo sé, que después de yo muerto, corrompiendo os corromperéis, y os apartaréis del camino que os he mandado: y que os ha de venir mal en los prostreros días por haber hecho mal en ojos de Jehová, enojándole con la obra de vuestras manos.
texts.deu.31.30: Entonces habló Moisés en oídos de toda la congregación de Israel las palabras de esta canción, hasta acabarla.
texts.deu.32.1: Escuchád cielos, y hablaré: y oiga la tierra los dichos de mi boca.
texts.deu.32.2: Goteará, como la lluvia, mi doctrina: destilará, como el rocío, mi dicho: como las mollinas sobre la grama, y como las gotas sobre la yerba.
texts.deu.32.3: Porque el nombre de Jehová invocaré, dad grandeza a nuestro Dios.
texts.deu.32.4: Del Fuerte, cuya obra es perfecta: porque todos sus caminos son juicio, Dios de verdad: y no hay iniquidad, justo y recto es.
texts.deu.32.5: La corrupción no es suya: a sus hijos la mancha de ellos, generación torcida y perversa.
texts.deu.32.6: ¿Así pagáis a Jehová? pueblo loco, e ignorante: ¿no es él tu padre que te poseyó? él te hizo y te compuso.
texts.deu.32.7: Acuérdate de los tiempos antiguos, considerád los años de generación y generación: pregunta a tu padre, que él te declarará: a tus viejos, y ellos te dirán:
texts.deu.32.8: Cuando el Altísimo hizo heredar a las gentes; cuando hizo dividir los hijos de los hombres; cuando estableció los términos de los pueblos según el número de los hijos de Israel.
texts.deu.32.9: Porque la parte de Jehová es su pueblo, Jacob el cordel de su heredad.
texts.deu.32.10: Hallóle en tierra de desierto, y en un desierto horrible y yermo: trájole al derredor, instruyóle, guardóle como la niña de su ojo.
texts.deu.32.11: Como el águila despierta su nido, vuela sobre sus pollos, extiende sus alas, tómale, llévale sobre sus espaldas:
texts.deu.32.12: Jehová solo le guió, que no hubo con él dios ajeno.
texts.deu.32.13: Hízole subir sobre las alturas de la tierra, y comió los frutos del campo, e hizo que chupase miel de la peña, y aceite de pedernal fuerte;
texts.deu.32.14: Manteca de vacas, y leche de ovejas, con grosura de corderos, y carneros de Basán: y machos de cabrío con grosura de riñones de trigo, y sangre de uva bebiste vino.
texts.deu.32.15: Y engordó el Recto, y tiró coces: engordástete, engrosástete, cubrístete, y dejó al Dios, que lo hizo: y menospreció al Fuerte de su salud.
texts.deu.32.16: Despertáronle a celos con los ajenos, ensañáronle con las abominaciones.
texts.deu.32.17: Sacrificaron a los diablos, no a Dios: a los dioses, que no conocieron: nuevos, venidos de cerca, que vuestros padres no los temieron.
texts.deu.32.18: Del Fuerte que te crió, te has olvidado, háste olvidado del Dios tu criador.
texts.deu.32.19: Y viólo Jehová, y encendióse con ira de sus hijos y de sus hijas.
texts.deu.32.20: Y dijo: Esconderé de ellos mi rostro, veré cual será su prostrimería: que son generación de perversidades, hijos sin fe.
texts.deu.32.21: Ellos me despertaron a celos con el que no es Dios: hiciéronme ensañar con sus vanidades: y yo los despertaré a celos con los que no son pueblo, con gente loca les haré ensañar.
texts.deu.32.22: Porque fuego se encenderá en mi furor, y arderá hasta el profundo: y tragará la tierra y sus frutos, y abrasará los fundamentos de los montes.
texts.deu.32.23: Yo allegaré males sobre ellos, mis saetas acabaré en ellos.
texts.deu.32.24: Consumidos de hambre, y comidos de fiebre ardiente, y de pestilencia amarga: y diente de bestias enviaré sobre ellos, con veneno de serpientes de la tierra.
texts.deu.32.25: De fuera deshijará la espada, y en las recámaras amedrentamiento: así el mancebo como la doncella, el que mama como el hombre cano.
texts.deu.32.26: Dije: Yo los echaría del mundo, haría cesar de los hombres la memoria de ellos.
texts.deu.32.27: Si no temiese la ira del enemigo, porque no enagenen mi gloria sus adversarios, porque no digan: Nuestra mano alta ha hecho todo esto, no Jehová.
texts.deu.32.28: Porque son gente de perdidos consejos, y no hay en ellos entendimiento.
texts.deu.32.29: ¡Ojalá fueran sabios, entendieran esto, entendieran su prostrimería!
texts.deu.32.30: ¿Cómo podría perseguir uno a mil, y dos harían huir a diez mil, si su Fuerte no los hubiese vendido, y Jehová no los hubiese entregado?
texts.deu.32.31: Que el fuerte de ellos no es como nuestro Fuerte: y nuestros enemigos sean jueces.
texts.deu.32.32: Por tanto de la vid de Sodoma es la vid de ellos, y de los sarmientos de Gomorra: las uvas de ellos son uvas ponzoñosas, racimos de amarguras tienen.
texts.deu.32.33: Veneno de dragones es su vino, y ponzoña cruel de áspides.
texts.deu.32.34: ¿No tengo yo esto guardado, sellado en mis tesoros?
texts.deu.32.35: Mía es la venganza y el pago, al tiempo que su pie vacilará: porque el día de su aflicción está cercano, y lo que les está determinado se apresura.
texts.deu.32.36: Porque Jehová juzgará a su pueblo, y sobre sus siervos se arrepentirá, cuando viere que la fuerza pereció sin quedar guardado ni desamparado.
texts.deu.32.37: Y dirá: ¿Dónde están sus dioses, el fuerte de quien se ampararon,
texts.deu.32.38: Que comían el sebo de sus sacrificios, bebían el vino de sus derramaduras? levántense, y os ayuden, os amparen.
texts.deu.32.39: Ved ahora que yo, yo soy, y no hay dioses conmigo: yo hago morir, y yo hago vivir: yo hiero y yo curo: y no hay quien escape de mi mano.
texts.deu.32.40: Cuando yo alzaré a los cielos mi mano, y diré: Vivo yo para siempre.
texts.deu.32.41: Si afilare mi espada reluciente, y mi mano arrebatare el juicio, yo volveré la venganza a mis enemigos, y daré el pago a los que me aborrecen.
texts.deu.32.42: Embriagaré mis saetas en sangre, y mi espada tragará carne: en la sangre de los muertos y de los cautivos de las cabezas, con venganzas de enemigo.
texts.deu.32.43: Alabád gentes a su pueblo, porque él vengará la sangre de sus siervos, y volverá la venganza a sus enemigos, y expiará su tierra, a su pueblo.
texts.deu.32.44: Y vino Moisés, y recitó todas las palabras de esta canción a oídos del pueblo, él y Josué hijo de Nun.
texts.deu.32.45: Y acabó Moisés de recitar todas estas palabras a todo Israel.
texts.deu.32.46: Y díjoles: Ponéd vuestro corazón a todas las palabras que yo protesto hoy contra vosotros, para que las mandéis a vuestros hijos, que guarden y hagan todas las palabras de esta ley,
texts.deu.32.47: Porque no os es cosa vana, mas es vuestra vida: y por este negocio haréis prolongar los días sobre la tierra, para heredar la cual pasáis el Jordán.
texts.deu.32.48: Y habló Jehová a Moisés aquel mismo día, diciendo:
texts.deu.32.49: Sube a este monte de Abarim, al monte de Nebo, que está en la tierra de Moab, que está en derecho de Jericó; y mira la tierra de Canaán, que yo doy a los hijos de Israel por heredad:
texts.deu.32.50: Y muere en el monte al cual subes, y sé agregado a tus pueblos, de la manera que murió Aarón tu hermano en el monte de Hor, y fue agregado a sus pueblos:
texts.deu.32.51: Por cuanto prevaricasteis contra mí en medio de los hijos de Israel a las aguas de la rencilla de Cádes del desierto de Zín; porque no me santificasteis en medio de los hijos de Israel.
texts.deu.32.52: Por tanto delante verás la tierra, mas no entrarás allá, a la tierra que yo doy a los hijos de Israel.
texts.deu.33.1: Y esta es la bendición con la cual Moisés, varón de Dios, bendijo a los hijos de Israel antes que muriese;
texts.deu.33.2: Y dijo: Jehová vino de Sinaí, y de Seir les esclareció: resplandeció desde el monte de Farán, y vino con diez mil santos: a su diestra la ley de fuego para ellos.
texts.deu.33.3: Aun amó los pueblos, todos sus santos están en tu mano: ellos también se llegaron a tus pies: recibieron de tus dichos.
texts.deu.33.4: Ley nos mandó Moisés por heredad a la congregación de Jacob.
texts.deu.33.5: Y fue en el Recto rey, cuando se congregaron las cabezas del pueblo, las tribus de Israel en uno.
texts.deu.33.6: Viva Rubén, y no muera: y sean sus varones en número.
texts.deu.33.7: Y esta para Judá; y dijo: Oye oh Jehová, la voz de Judá, y llévale a su pueblo: sus manos le basten, y tú le seas ayuda contra sus enemigos.
texts.deu.33.8: Y a Leví dijo: Tu Tumim y tu Urim diste a tu buen varón, al cual tentaste en Massa: y lo hiciste reñir a las aguas de la rencilla;
texts.deu.33.9: El que dijo a su padre y a su madre: Nunca los ví: ni conoció a sus hermanos, ni conoció a sus hijos: por lo cual ellos guardarán tus dichos, y observarán tu concierto.
texts.deu.33.10: Ellos enseñarán tus juicios a Jacob, y tu ley a Israel: pondrán el perfume a tus narices, y el holocausto sobre tu altar.
texts.deu.33.11: Bendice oh Jehová lo que hicieren, y en la obra de sus manos toma contentamiento: hiere los lomos de sus enemigos, y de los que le aborrecieren, que nunca se levanten.
texts.deu.33.12: Y a Ben-jamín dijo: El amado de Jehová habitará confiado cerca de él: cubrirle ha siempre, y entre sus hombros morará.
texts.deu.33.13: Y a José dijo: Bendita sea de Jehová su tierra por los regalos de los cielos, por el rocío, y por el abismo que está abajo,
texts.deu.33.14: Y por los regalos de los frutos del sol, y por los regalos de las influencias de las lunas,
texts.deu.33.15: Y por la cumbre de los montes antiguos; y por los regalos, de los collados eternos.
texts.deu.33.16: Y por los regalos de la tierra, y su plenitud: y la gracia del que habitó en la zarza venga sobre la cabeza de José, y sobre la mollera del apartado de sus hermanos.
texts.deu.33.17: El es hermoso como el primogénito de su buey: y sus cuernos, cuernos de unicornio: con ellos acorneará los pueblos a una, hasta los fines de la tierra: y estos son los diez millares de Efraím: y estos los millares de Manasés.
texts.deu.33.18: Y a Zabulón dijo: Alégrate Zabulón cuando salieres; e Isacar en tus tiendas.
texts.deu.33.19: Al monte llamarán pueblos, allí sacrificarán sacrificios de justicia: por lo cual chuparán la abundancia de las mares, y los tesoros escondidos del arena.
texts.deu.33.20: Y a Gad dijo: Bendito el que hizo ensanchar a Gad: como león habitará, y arrebatará brazo y mollera.
texts.deu.33.21: El vio para sí lo primero, que allí estaba escondida la parte del legislador, y vino en la delantera del pueblo: la justicia de Jehová hará, y sus juicios con Israel.
texts.deu.33.22: Y a Dan dijo: Dan, cachorro de león: saltará desde Basán.
texts.deu.33.23: Y a Neftalí dijo: Neftalí harto de voluntad, y lleno de bendición de Jehová; el occidente y el mediodía hereda.
texts.deu.33.24: Y a Aser dijo: Bendito más que los hijos, Aser; será agradable a sus hermanos: y mojará en aceite su pie.
texts.deu.33.25: Hierro y metal serán tus cerraduras; y como tus días será tu fortaleza.
texts.deu.33.26: No hay otro como el Dios del Recto: caballero en el cielo para tu ayuda, y en los cielos con su grandeza.
texts.deu.33.27: La habitación de Dios es eterna, y debajo de brazos de perpetuidad: él echará de delante de ti al enemigo; y dirá: Destruye.
texts.deu.33.28: E Israel, la fuente de Jacob, habitará confiado solo en tierra de grano y de vino: también sus cielos destilarán rocío.
texts.deu.33.29: Bienaventurado tú Israel: ¿Quién como tú, pueblo salvo por Jehová, escudo de tu socorro, y espada de tu excelencia? Y tus enemigos serán humillados, y tú hollarás sobre sus alturas.
texts.deu.34.1: Y subió Moisés de los campos de Moab al monte de Nebo a la cumbre de Fasga, que está enfrente de Jericó; y mostróle Jehová toda la tierra de Galaad hasta Dan,
texts.deu.34.2: Y a todo Neftalí, y la tierra de Efraím y de Manasés, toda la tierra de Judá hasta la mar prostrera.
texts.deu.34.3: Y el mediodía, y la campaña, la vega de Jericó, ciudad de las palmas, hasta Segor.
texts.deu.34.4: Y díjole Jehová: Esta es la tierra, de que juré a Abraham, Isaac, y Jacob, diciendo: A tu simiente la daré. Hechotela he ver con tus ojos, mas no pasarás allá.
texts.deu.34.5: Y murió allí Moisés siervo de Jehová, en la tierra de Moab, conforme al dicho de Jehová.
texts.deu.34.6: Y enterróle en el valle, en tierra de Moab enfrente de Bet-pehor: y ninguno supo su sepulcro hasta hoy.
texts.deu.34.7: Y era Moisés de edad de ciento y veinte años cuando murió: sus ojos nunca se oscurecieron, ni perdió su vigor.
texts.deu.34.8: Y lloraron los hijos de Israel a Moisés en los campos de Moab treinta días: y cumpliéronse los días del lloro del luto de Moisés.
texts.deu.34.9: Y Josué hijo de Nun fue lleno de espíritu de sabiduría, porque Moisés había puesto sus manos sobre él: y los hijos de Israel le obedecieron, e hicieron como Jehová mandó a Moisés.
texts.deu.34.10: Y nunca más se levantó profeta en Israel como Moisés, aquien haya conocido Jehová cara a cara,
texts.deu.34.11: En todas las señales y los milagros que le envió Jehová a hacer en tierra de Egipto a Faraón, y a todos sus siervos, y a toda su tierra,
texts.deu.34.12: Y en toda la mano fuerte, y en todo el espanto grande, que hizo Moisés a ojos de todo Israel.

texts.deu.1.1: These, are the words, which Moses spake unto all Israel, over the Jordan,—in the wilderness in the waste plain over against Suph, between Paran and Tophel, and Laban and Hazeroth and Di-zahab:
texts.deu.1.2: eleven days from Horeb, by way of Mount Seir, as far as Kadesh-barnea.
texts.deu.1.3: And it came to pass, in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month, that Moses spake unto the sons of Israel, according to all that Yahweh had given him in charge for them;
texts.deu.1.4: after he had smitten Sihon, king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon,—and Og, king of Bashan, who dwelt in Ashtaroth, in Edrei:
texts.deu.1.5: over the Jordan, in the land of Moab, did Moses take in hand to expound this law, saying:—
texts.deu.1.6: Yahweh our God, spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Long enough, have ye dwelt in this mountain:
texts.deu.1.7: Turn ye and set yourselves forward, and enter into the hill country of the Amorites, and into all the places near, in the plain, in the mountain, and in the lowland, and in the south, and in the coast of the sea,—the land of Canaan and the Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
texts.deu.1.8: See! I have set before you the land,—enter and possess the land, which, Yahweh sware unto your fathers to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give unto them, and unto their seed, after them.
texts.deu.1.9: So I spake unto you, at that time saying, I am unable, by myself, to carry you.
texts.deu.1.10: Yahweh your God hath multiplied you, and here ye are to-day, like the stars of the heavens for multitude.
texts.deu.1.11: Yahweh, the God of your fathers, be adding unto you the like of you, a thousand times,—and bless you, as he hath spoken unto you!
texts.deu.1.12: How should I carry by myself the fatigue of you and the burden of you and your controversies?
texts.deu.1.13: Set forth for you—men wise and discerning, and known to your tribes,—that I may appoint them to be heads over you.
texts.deu.1.14: And ye answered me,—and said, Good, is the word which thou hast spoken to be done.
texts.deu.1.15: So I took heads for your tribes wise men and known, and placed them as heads over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties and captains of tens, and overseers for your tribes.
texts.deu.1.16: And I charged your judges, at that time, saying,—Ye are to hear between your brethren and shall judge righteously, between each man and his brother and his sojourner.
texts.deu.1.17: Ye shall not take note of faces in judgment—so the small as the great, shall ye hear, ye shall not shrink from the face of any man, for judgment, unto God, belongeth,—but the thing which is too hard for you, shall ye bring near unto me, and I will hear it.
texts.deu.1.18: So I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
texts.deu.1.19: And when we brake up from Horeb, we came through all that great and terrible desert which ye saw, by way of the hill-country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us,—and we entered in as far as Kadesh-barnea.
texts.deu.1.20: Then said I unto you,—Ye are come in as far as the hill-country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God, is giving unto us.
texts.deu.1.21: See thou—Yahweh thy God hath set before thee the land,—go up—take possession as Yahweh the God of thy fathers hath spoken unto thee, do not fear, neither be dismayed.
texts.deu.1.22: And ye came near unto me all of you, and said Let us send men before us, that they may search out for us the land,—and bring us back word, the way by which we must go up, and the cities whereinto we must enter,
texts.deu.1.23: And the thing, was good in mine eyes,—so I took from among you twelve men, one man for each tribe.
texts.deu.1.24: And they turned and went up the hill-country, and entered in as far as the ravine of Eshcol, and explored it.
texts.deu.1.25: And they took in their hand of the fruit of the country, and bare it down unto us, and brought us back word, and said, Good is the land, which Yahweh our God, is giving unto us.
texts.deu.1.26: Nevertheless ye were not willing to go up,—but rebelled against the bidding of Yahweh, your God;
texts.deu.1.27: and murmured in your tents and said, Because Yahweh hated us, hath he brought us forth out of the land of Egypt,—to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
texts.deu.1.28: Whither, are, we, to go up? Our own brethren, have made our heart melt saying—A people greater and taller than we, cities large and walled-up into the heavens,—yea, moreover sons of Anakim, have we seen there.
texts.deu.1.29: Then I said unto you,—Ye must not tremble, nor be afraid of them:
texts.deu.1.30: Yahweh your God, who is going before you, he, will fight for you,—according to all that he did with you in Egypt, before your eyes;
texts.deu.1.31: also in the desert which thou hast seen, where Yahweh thy God carried thee as a man will carry his son, throughout all the way that ye journeyed, until ye entered as far as, this place.
texts.deu.1.32: But in this thing, ye were putting no trust in Yahweh your God;
texts.deu.1.33: who was going before you in the way—to search out for you a place, where ye might encamp,—in the fire by night, that ye might get sight of the way wherein ye should go, and in the cloud, by day.
texts.deu.1.34: And Yahweh heard the voice of your words,—and was wroth and sware—saying:
texts.deu.1.35: Surely, not one of these men, this wicked generation,—shall see the good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers:
texts.deu.1.36: saving Caleb son of Jephunneh, he, shall see it, and unto him, will I give the land through which he hath trodden, and unto his sons,—because he hath wholly followed Yahweh.
texts.deu.1.37: Even with me, did Yahweh show himself angry, for your sakes, saying,—Even thou, shalt not enter therein.
texts.deu.1.38: Joshua son of Nun, who standeth before thee, he, shall enter in thither, him, strengthen thou, for he, shall cause Israel to inherit it.
texts.deu.1.39: And your little ones, of whom ye said they should become, a prey, and your sons who to-day know not good and evil, they, shall enter in thither,—and unto them, will I give it, and they, shall possess it.
texts.deu.1.40: But as for you, turn ye, for your part,—and set forward towards the desert, by way of the Red Sea.
texts.deu.1.41: Then responded ye and said unto me—We have sinned against Yahweh, We, ourselves, will go up, and fight, according to all that Yahweh our God hath commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye foolishly went up towards the hill-country.
texts.deu.1.42: Then said Yahweh unto me—Say unto them Ye shall not go up, nor fight, for I am not in your midst,—lest ye should be smitten before your enemies.
texts.deu.1.43: So I spake unto you howbeit ye hearkened not,—but rebelled against the bidding of Yahweh, and presumptuously went up the hill-country.
texts.deu.1.44: Then came forth the Amorites who were dwelling in that country, to meet you, and they chased you, as do, bees; and struck you down in Seir, as far as Hormah.
texts.deu.1.45: So then ye returned and wept before Yahweh,—but Yahweh hearkened not unto your voice, nor gave ear unto you.
texts.deu.1.46: And ye abode in Kadesh many days,—how many were the days that ye abode [there]!
texts.deu.2.1: Then turned we, and set forward towards the desert by way of the Red Sea, as Yahweh, spake unto me; and we encompassed Mount Seir many days.
texts.deu.2.2: And Yahweh spake unto me, saying:
texts.deu.2.3: Long enough, have ye encompassed this mountain,—turn yourselves north, wards.
texts.deu.2.4: And, the people, command thou saying, Ye are about to pass through the boundary of your brethren the sons of Esau, who are dwelling in Seir,—and should they be afraid of you, take ye good heed to yourselves:
texts.deu.2.5: do not engage in strife with them, for I will not give you of their land, so much as place for the tread of a foot-sole,—for as a possession to Esau, have I given Mount Seir.
texts.deu.2.6: Food, shall ye buy of them with silver so shall ye eat,—yea even water, shall ye buy of them with silver so shall ye drink.
texts.deu.2.7: For Yahweh thy God, hath blessed thee in all the work of thy hand, he hath considered thy traversing of this great desert,—these forty years, hath Yahweh thy God been with thee, thou hast lacked, nothing.
texts.deu.2.8: So we passed on, a way from our brethren the sons of Esau who dwell in Seir, from the way of the waste plain, from Elath, and from Ezion-geber,—and we turned and passed on by way of the desert of Moab.
texts.deu.2.9: And Yahweh said unto me—Do not lay siege to Moab, nor engage in strife with them in battle,—for I will not give unto thee of this land as a possession, for unto the sons of Lot, have I given Ar, as a possession.
texts.deu.2.10: the Emim, formerly dwelt therein,—a people great and many and tall, like the Anakim.
texts.deu.2.11: Giants, used, they also, to be accounted like the Anakim,—but the Moabites, called them Emim.
texts.deu.2.12: And in Seir, dwelt the Horim aforetime, but, the sons of Esau, dispossessed them, and destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead,—as did Israel unto the land of his own possession, which Yahweh had given unto them.
texts.deu.2.13: Now, arise, and pass ye over the ravine of Zered. So we passed over the ravine of Zered.
texts.deu.2.14: Now, the days in which we journeyed from Kadesh-barnea, as far as where we crossed the ravine of Zered, were thirty-eight years,—until all the generation of the men of war were consumed out of the midst of the camp, as Yahweh had sworn unto them.
texts.deu.2.15: Yea, even the hand of Yahweh was against them, to destroy them out of the midst of the camp,—until they were consumed.
texts.deu.2.16: So it came to pass when all the men of war were consumed by dying, out of the midst of the people,
texts.deu.2.17: then spake Yahweh unto me, saying:
texts.deu.2.18: Thou, art passing, to-day, the boundary of Moab even Ar;
texts.deu.2.19: so wilt thou draw near over against the sons of Ammon, do not thou besiege them neither engage in strife with them,—for I will not give of the land of the sons of Ammon unto thee as a possession, for unto the sons of Lot, have I given it as a possession.
texts.deu.2.20: A land of giants, used, that also, to be accounted,—giants, dwelt therein aforetime, but the Ammonites, called them Zamzummim:
texts.deu.2.21: a people great and many and tall, like the Anakim,—but Yahweh destroyed them from before them, and they took their possessions, and dwelt in their stead:
texts.deu.2.22: as he did for the sons of Esau, who are dwelling in Seir,—when he destroyed the Horim from before them, and they took their possessions and have dwelt in their stead, even unto this day.
texts.deu.2.23: The Avvim also, who dwelt in settlements as far as Gaza, Caphtorim, who were coming forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.
texts.deu.2.24: Arise ye, set forward and cross over the ravine of Arnon, see! I have given into thy hand—Sihon king of Heshbon, the Amorite and his land, begin—take possession,—and engage in strife with him in battle.
texts.deu.2.25: This day, will I begin to extend the dread of thee and the fear of thee over the face of the peoples under all the heavens,—who will hear the report of thee, then will they quake and writhe in pain because of thee.
texts.deu.2.26: So I sent messengers out of the desert of Kademoth, unto Sihon, king of Heshbon,—with words of peace saying:
texts.deu.2.27: I would pass along through thy land, by the road, by the road, will I go,—I will not turn aside, to the right hand or to the left:
texts.deu.2.28: Food for silver, shalt thou sell me so will I eat, and water for silver, shalt thou let me have, so will I drink,—only I would pass through on my feet;—
texts.deu.2.29: as the sons of Esau, who are dwelling in Seir, did to me, and the Moabites who are dwelling in Ar,—until that I pass over the Jordan, into the land which, Yahweh our God, is giving unto us.
texts.deu.2.30: But Sihon king of Heshbon, was not willing, to let us pass along through it,—for Yahweh thy God had suffered him to make his spirit harsh and his heart bold, that he might give him into thy hand—(as [appeareth] this day).
texts.deu.2.31: Then said Yahweh unto me, See! I have begun to deliver up before thee Sihon and his land,—begin take possession, that thou mayest make a possession of his land.
texts.deu.2.32: So then Sihon came out to meet us he, and all his people, to give battle at Jahaz.
texts.deu.2.33: And Yahweh our God delivered him up before us,—and we smote him and his sons, and all his people
texts.deu.2.34: And we captured all his cities, at that time, and devoted to destruction every city of males, with the women and the little ones,—we left not remaining a survivor:
texts.deu.2.35: only the cattle, made we our prey,—and the spoil of the cities which we captured.
texts.deu.2.36: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the ravine of Arnon and the city that is in the ravine even as far as Gilead, there was not a fortress that proved too high for us,—the whole, did Yahweh our God deliver up before us.
texts.deu.2.37: Only unto the land of the sons of Ammon, didst thou not come near,—all the side of the Jabbok ravine, nor the cities of the hill country, nor any which Yahweh our God had forbidden to us.
texts.deu.3.1: Then turned we and went up, the way of Bashan; and Og king of Bashan, came out to meet us, he, and all his people, to give battle at Edrei.
texts.deu.3.2: And Yahweh said unto me: Do not fear him, for into thy hand, have I delivered him and all his people and his land,—so then thou shalt do unto him, as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites who was dwelling in Heshbon.
texts.deu.3.3: Then did Yahweh our God deliver into our hand, Og also, king of Bashan and all his people,—so we smote him until there was not left remaining to him a survivor.
texts.deu.3.4: And we captured all his cities, at that time, there was no fortress which we took not from them,—sixty cities all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
texts.deu.3.5: All these, were fortified cities each with a high wall, folding gates and a bar,—besides country towns exceeding many.
texts.deu.3.6: And we devoted them to destruction, doing unto them as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon,—devoting to destruction every city of males, the women, and the little ones.
texts.deu.3.7: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, made we our prey.
texts.deu.3.8: Thus did we at that time take the land out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites (which was over the Jordan),—from the ravine of Arnon as far as Mount Hermon.
texts.deu.3.9: Sidonians, call Hermon Sirion,—but, the Amorites, call it Senir.
texts.deu.3.10: All the cities of the table-land, and all Gilead, and all Bashan,—unto Salecah, and Edrei,—cities of the kingdom of Og, in Bashan.
texts.deu.3.11: For, only Og, king of Bashan was left remaining of the remnant of the giants, lo! his bedstead, was a bedstead of iron, is not, the same, in Rabbath of the sons of Ammon? nine cubits, the length thereof and four cubits, the breadth thereof, by the fore-arm of a man.
texts.deu.3.12: And this land, took we in possession at that time,—from Aroer which is by the ravine of Arnon, and half the hill-country of Gilead and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites;
texts.deu.3.13: but the remainder of Gilead, and all Bashan the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh,—all the region of the Argob with all Bashan. The same, is called, A land of giants.
texts.deu.3.14: Jair, son of Manasseh, took all the region of Argob, as far as the boundary of the Geshurites, and the Maachathites,—and called them after his own name The Bashan of Havvoth-jair unto this day.
texts.deu.3.15: And, unto Machir, gave I Gilead;
texts.deu.3.16: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites, gave I—from Gilead even as far as the ravine of Arnon, the middle of the ravine and boundary,—even as far as the Jabbok ravine, the boundary of the sons of Ammon;
texts.deu.3.17: the Waste Plain also and the Jordan and boundary,—from Chinnereth, even as far as the sea of the Waste Plain the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah, on the east.
texts.deu.3.18: So I commanded you, at that time saying,—Yahweh your God hath given unto you this land to possess it, armed, shall ye pass over before your brethren the sons of Israel all the sons of valour,
texts.deu.3.19: Only, your wives and your little ones and your cattle—I know that ye have much cattle—shall abide in your cities which I have given unto you;
texts.deu.3.20: until that Yahweh shall give rest unto your brethren, as well as you, so shall, they too, possess the land which, Yahweh your God, is giving unto them, over the Jordan,—then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given unto you.
texts.deu.3.21: Joshua also, commanded I, at that time saying,—Thine are the eyes, that have seen all that Yahweh your God hath done unto these two kings, thus, will Yahweh do unto all the kingdoms whereunto thou, art passing over:
texts.deu.3.22: ye shall not fear them,—for, Yahweh your God, he, it is that is fighting for you.
texts.deu.3.23: Then sought I Yahweh at that time, for a favour saying:
texts.deu.3.24: My Lord Yahweh, thou thyself, hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy firm hand,—as to which, what GOD is there, in the heavens or in the earth, that can do according to thy doings, and according to thy mighty deeds?
texts.deu.3.25: Let me pass over, I pray thee that I may see the good land that is over the Jordan,—this good mountain, and the Lebanon.
texts.deu.3.26: But Yahweh had been provoked with me for your sakes, and hearkened not unto me,—and Yahweh said unto me, Enough for thee! do not add a word unto me further in this matter.
texts.deu.3.27: Ascend the top of the Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes—westward, and northward and southward and eastward—and see with thine own eyes,—for thou shalt not pass over this Jordan.
texts.deu.3.28: But command thou Joshua and confirm him and embolden him,—for, he, shall pass over before this people, and, he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
texts.deu.3.29: So we abode in the valley, over against Beth-peor.
texts.deu.4.1: Now, therefore, O Israel, hearken thou unto the statutes, and unto the regulations, which, I, am teaching you, to do [them],—to the end ye may live and enter and possess the land, which, Yahweh, the God of your fathers, is giving unto you.
texts.deu.4.2: Ye shall not add unto the word which, I, am commanding you, neither shall ye take away therefrom,—that ye may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, which, I, am commanding you.
texts.deu.4.3: Yours are the eyes, that have seen what Yahweh did in Baal-peor, for every man who went after Baal-peor, did Yahweh thy God destroy out of thy midst;
texts.deu.4.4: but, ye who kept on cleaving unto Yahweh your God, alive, are ye all to-day.
texts.deu.4.5: See! I have taught you statutes, and regulations, as Yahweh my God commanded me,—that ye should do so, in the midst of the land whereinto ye are entering to possess it.
texts.deu.4.6: Therefore shall ye observe, and do [them], for that, will be your wisdom, and discernment, in the eyes of the peoples,—who will hear all these statutes, and will say—Nevertheless, a people wise and discerning, is this great nation.
texts.deu.4.7: For what great nation is there which hath gods nigh unto it,—like Yahweh our God, whensoever we have cried out unto him.
texts.deu.4.8: Or what great nation which hath righteous statutes and regulations, like all this law, which, I, am setting before you to-day?
texts.deu.4.9: Only take thou heed to thyself and keep thy soul diligently, so that thou forget not the things which thine own eyes have seen, and so that they go not out of thy heart, all the days of thy life,—but thou shalt make them known unto thy sons and unto thy sons’ sons:—
texts.deu.4.10: What day thou didst stand before Yahweh thy God, in Horeb, when Yahweh said unto me, Gather unto me the people, that I may let them hear my words,—which they must learn that they may revere me all the days which they are living upon the soil, their children also, must they teach.
texts.deu.4.11: So ye drew near and stood, under the mountain. Now, the mountain, was burning with fire, up to the midst of the heavens,—darkness, cloud, and thick gloom.
texts.deu.4.12: Then spake Yahweh unto you out of the midst of the fire,—a voice of words, ye were hearing, no form, were ye seeing, there was only a voice.
texts.deu.4.13: Then declared he unto you his covenant which he commanded you to do, the ten words,—and wrote them upon two tables of stone.
texts.deu.4.14: And unto me, gave Yahweh command, at that time, to teach you statutes and regulations,—that ye should do them, in the land whereinto ye are passing over to possess it.
texts.deu.4.15: Ye must take diligent heed, therefore unto your own souls, for ye saw no manner of form, on the day Yahweh spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire;
texts.deu.4.16: lest ye should break faith, and make you an image, a form of any likeness,—a model of male or female;
texts.deu.4.17: a model of any beast that is in the earth,—a model of any winged bird, that flieth in the heavens;
texts.deu.4.18: a model of any thing that creepeth on the ground,—a model of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth;
texts.deu.4.19: or lest thou shouldest lift up thine eyes towards the heavens and see the sun and the moon, and the stars—all the host of the heavens, and shouldest be seduced, and shouldest bow thyself down to them and he led to serve them,—the which Yahweh thy God hath assigned unto all the peoples under all the heavens;
texts.deu.4.20: whereas you, hath Yahweh taken, and brought you forth out of a smelting-pot of iron, out of Egypt,—that ye might become his own inherited people as at this day.
texts.deu.4.21: But, Yahweh shewed himself angry with me, for your sakes,—and sware that I should not pass over the Jordan, and that I should not enter into the good land, which, Yahweh thy God, is giving unto thee as an inheritance;
texts.deu.4.22: for, I, am about to die in this land, I am not to pass over the Jordan,—but, ye, are to pass over, and possess this good land.
texts.deu.4.23: Take heed to yourselves lest ye forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he hath solemnised with you,—and so make for yourselves an image, the form of anything, the which Yahweh thy God hath forbidden thee;
texts.deu.4.24: seeing that as for Yahweh thy God, a consuming fire, he is,—a jealous GOD.
texts.deu.4.25: When thou shalt beget sons, and sons’ sons, and become careless in the land and break faith and make an image the form of any thing, and shalt do the thing that is wicked in the eyes of Yahweh thy God provoking him to anger,
texts.deu.4.26: I take both the heavens and the earth to witness against you to-day, that ye shall, perish, speedily, from off the land which ye are passing over the Jordan to possess,—ye shall not prolong your days thereupon; for, ye shall surely be laid waste;
texts.deu.4.27: and Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples,—and ye shall have left remaining of you men easily counted, among the nations whither Yahweh will drive you;
texts.deu.4.28: and ye will serve there gods made by the hands of man,—wood or stone, which neither see nor hear nor eat nor smell.
texts.deu.4.29: If thou shalt seek from thence, Yahweh thy God, then shalt thou find him,—when thou shalt search after him with all thy heart, and with all thy soul.
texts.deu.4.30: In thy distress, when all these things have found thee out—in the afterpart of the days, thou wilt return unto Yahweh thy God, and wilt hearken to his voice.
texts.deu.4.31: For, a GOD of compassion, is Yahweh thy God, he will not forsake thee neither will he destroy thee,—nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
texts.deu.4.32: For ask, I pray you, of the former days which were before thee, even from the day when God created man upon the earth, yea from one end of the heavens even to the other end of the heavens,—whether aught was ever brought to pass, like this great thing, or was ever heard of like it:
texts.deu.4.33: Did a people ever hear the voice of a god speaking out of the midst of fire, as, thou, didst hear, and yet live?
texts.deu.4.34: Or did a god ever make trial of entering in to take unto him a nation out of the midst of a nation, by provings, by signs and by wonders and by fighting, and by a firm hand and by a stretched-out arm, and by great terrors,—according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt, before your eyes?
texts.deu.4.35: Thou, wast allowed to see that thou mightest know, that Yahweh, he is God, there is none other than he alone.
texts.deu.4.36: Out of the heavens, he let thee hear his voice to instruct thee,—and, upon the earth, he let thee see his great fire, and his own words, thou didst hear out of the midst of the fire.
texts.deu.4.37: And because that he loved thy fathers, therefore chose he his seed after him,—and brought thee forth with his presence with his great might, out of Egypt;
texts.deu.4.38: to dispossess nations, greater and stronger than thou from before thee,—to bring thee in. to give unto thee their land for an inheritance: As at this day.
texts.deu.4.39: So then thou must consider to-day, and bring it back to thy heart, that, Yahweh, he is God in the heavens above and upon the earth beneath,—there is none other.
texts.deu.4.40: So shalt thou keep his statutes and his commandments which, I, am commanding thee to-day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy sons after thee,—and to the end thou mayest prolong thy days upon the soil, which Yahweh thy God, is giving thee, all the days.
texts.deu.4.41: Then, did Moses set apart three cities, over the Jordan,—towards the rising of the sun:
texts.deu.4.42: that the manslayer might flee thither who should slay his neighbour unawares, he, not having hated him, aforetime,—and might flee unto one of these cities, and live:
texts.deu.4.43: namely Bezer, in the desert of the table-land, for the Reubenites,—and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
texts.deu.4.44: This, then is the law which Moses set before the sons of Israel:
texts.deu.4.45: These, are the testimonies, and the statutes and the regulations,—which Moses spake unto the sons of Israel when they came forth out of Egypt:
texts.deu.4.46: over the Jordan in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon,—whom Moses and the sons of Israel smote, when they came forth out of Egypt:
texts.deu.4.47: so they took possession of his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan the two kings of the Amorites, who were over the Jordan,—towards the rising of the sun;
texts.deu.4.48: from Aroer which is on the edge of the ravine of Arnon, even unto Mount Sion, the same, is Hermon;
texts.deu.4.49: and all the waste plain over the Jordan, towards sunrise, even unto the sea of the waste plain,—under the slopes of the Pisgah.
texts.deu.5.1: Then called Moses unto all Israel and said unto them—Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the regulations, which I am speaking in your ears to-day,—so shall ye learn them, and observe to do them.
texts.deu.5.2: Yahweh our God, solemnised with us a covenant in Horeb:
texts.deu.5.3: not with our fathers did Yahweh solemnise this covenant,—but with us, ourselves—these here to-day, all of us living.
texts.deu.5.4: Face to face, spake Yahweh with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
texts.deu.5.5: (I was standing between Yahweh and you, at that time, to declare unto you the word of Yahweh,—for ye shrank with fear from the presence of the fire, and went not up in the mount) saying:—
texts.deu.5.6: I, am Yahweh thy God, who have brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt out of the house of servants:—
texts.deu.5.7: Thou shalt not have other gods, besides me:
texts.deu.5.8: Thou shalt not make unto thee an image, any form that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
texts.deu.5.9: thou shalt not bow thyself down to them nor be led to serve them,—for, I Yahweh thy God, am a jealous GOD, visiting the iniquity of fathers upon sons even unto three generations and unto four, unto them that hate me;
texts.deu.5.10: but shewing lovingkindness unto a thousand generation—unto them who love me, and keep my commandments:
texts.deu.5.11: Thou shalt not utter the name of Yahweh thy God, for falsehood,—for Yahweh will not let him go unpunished who uttereth his name for falsehood:
texts.deu.5.12: Observe the sabbath day, to hallow it,—as Yahweh thy God, hath commanded thee:
texts.deu.5.13: six days, shalt thou labour, and do all thy work;
texts.deu.5.14: but, the seventh day, is a sabbath unto Yahweh thy God,—thou shalt do no work—thou nor thy son nor thy daughter nor thy servant nor thy handmaid nor thine ox nor thine ass nor any of thy cattle, nor thy sojourner who is within thy gates, that thy servant and thy handmaid may rest, as well as thou.
texts.deu.5.15: So shalt thou remember that a servant, wast thou in the land of Egypt, and that Yahweh thy God brought thee forth from thence, with a firm hand, and with a stretched-out arm,—for this cause, hath Yahweh thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day:
texts.deu.5.16: Honour thy father and thy mother, as Yahweh thy God hath commanded thee,—that thy days may be prolonged and that it may go well with thee, upon the soil which Yahweh thy God is about to give unto thee:
texts.deu.5.20: Neither shalt thou testify against thy neighbour with a witness of falsehood:
texts.deu.5.21: Neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s wife,—neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his servant, or his handmaid, his ox or his ass, or anything that is thy neighbour’s.
texts.deu.5.22: These words, spake Yahweh unto all the convocation of you in the mount out of the midst of the fire the cloud and the thick gloom, a loud voice, and added not,—and he wrote them upon two tables of stone, and gave them unto me.
texts.deu.5.23: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, the mountain also burning with fire, then drew ye near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes and your elders,
texts.deu.5.24: and ye said—Lo! Yahweh our God hath let us see his glory and his greatness, his voice also, have we heard out of the midst of the fire,—this day, have we seen, that God may speak with man who yet may live.
texts.deu.5.25: Now, therefore why should we die? for this great fire, will consume, us,—if we ourselves, hear the voice of Yahweh our God any more, we shall die.
texts.deu.5.26: For who [is there] of all flesh, that ever heard the voice of a Living God speaking out of the midst of fire as we, and yet lived?
texts.deu.5.27: Go, thou, near, and hear, all that Yahweh our God shall say,—so shalt thou speak unto us, all that Yahweh our God shall speak unto thee and we will hear and do.
texts.deu.5.28: And Yahweh heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me,—and Yahweh said unto me—I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken unto thee, they have well said all which they have spoken.
texts.deu.5.29: Oh that this their heart might remain in them to revere me, and to keep all my commandments all the days,—that it might be well with them and with their sons unto times age-abiding.
texts.deu.5.30: Go, say unto them,—Return ye to your tents.
texts.deu.5.31: Thou, therefore here stand with me and let me speak unto thee—all the commandment and the statutes and the regulations which thou shalt teach them,—that they may do [them] in the land which I am giving unto them to possess it.
texts.deu.5.32: So then ye must observe to do, as Yahweh your God hath commanded you,—ye must not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
texts.deu.5.33: In all the way which Yahweh your God hath commanded you, must ye walk,—that ye may live and it be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land, which ye shall possess.
texts.deu.6.1: This, then is the commandment—[namely] the statutes and the regulations, which Yahweh your God hath commanded to teach you,—that ye may do them in the land whither ye are passing over to possess it:
texts.deu.6.2: that thou mayest revere Yahweh thy God, [so as] to keep all his statutes and his commandments which I am commanding thee, thou and thy son and thy sons’ son, all the days of thy life,—and that thy days may be prolonged.
texts.deu.6.3: Therefore shalt thou hear, O Israel, and shalt observe to do, that it may be well with thee, and that ye may multiply greatly, as Yahweh the God of thy fathers hath spoken to thee, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
texts.deu.6.4: Hear, O Israel: Yahweh, is our God,—Yahweh alone.
texts.deu.6.5: Thou shalt therefore love Yahweh thy God,—with all thy heart and with all thy soul, and with all thy might;
texts.deu.6.6: so shall these words which I am commanding thee to-day, be upon thy heart;
texts.deu.6.7: and thou shalt impress them upon thy sons, and shalt speak of them,—when thou sittest in thy house and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down and when thou risest up;
texts.deu.6.8: and thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thy hand,—and they shall serve for bands between thine eyes;
texts.deu.6.9: and thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house and within thy gates.
texts.deu.6.10: So shall it be, when Yahweh thy God shall bring thee into the land, which he sware to thy fathers—to Abraham to Isaac and to Jacob to give unto thee,—into cities great and goodly, which thou didst not build;
texts.deu.6.11: and houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and hewn cisterns which thou hewedst not, vineyards and oliveyards which thou plantedst not,—and shalt eat and be full,
texts.deu.6.12: take heed unto thyself, lest thou forget Yahweh,—who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt out of the house of servants.
texts.deu.6.13: Yahweh thy God, shalt thou revere And him, shalt thou serve,—And by his name, shalt thou swear.
texts.deu.6.14: Ye shall not go after other gods,—of the gods of the peoples who are surrounding you;
texts.deu.6.15: for a jealous GOD, is Yahweh thy God in thy midst,—lest the anger of Yahweh thy God kindle upon thee, and so he destroy thee from off the face of the ground.
texts.deu.6.16: Ye shall not put Yahweh your God to the proof,—as ye put him to the proof in Massah [that is, "The place of proving"].
texts.deu.6.17: Ye shall, keep, the commandments of Yahweh your God and his testimonies and his statutes which he hath commanded thee;
texts.deu.6.18: so shalt thou do what is right and what is pleasing in the eyes of Yahweh,—that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest enter in and possess the good land, which Yahweh sware unto thy fathers;
texts.deu.6.19: to thrust out all thine enemies from before thee,—As spake Yahweh.
texts.deu.6.20: When thy son shall ask thee in time to come, saying,—What mean the testimonies and the statutes and the regulations, which Yahweh our God commanded you?
texts.deu.6.21: Then shalt thou say unto thy son, Servants, were we unto Pharaoh in Egypt,—and Yahweh brought us forth out of Egypt with a firm hand;
texts.deu.6.22: and Yahweh put forth signs and wonders great and sore upon Egypt upon Pharaoh and upon all his household before our eyes;
texts.deu.6.23: but he brought us forth from thence,—that he might bring us in, to give unto us the land, which he sware unto our fathers.
texts.deu.6.24: So then Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to revere Yahweh our God,—for our good, all the days, to preserve us alive (as at this day);
texts.deu.6.25: and righteousness, shall it be to us,—when we take heed to do all this commandment, before Yahweh our God, as he commanded us.
texts.deu.7.1: When Yahweh thy God shall bring thee into the land which thou art going in to possess, and shall clear away many nations from before thee—the Hittites and the Girgashites and the Amorites, and the Canaanites and the Perizzites, and the Hivites and the Jebusites—seven nations greater in number and stronger than thou;
texts.deu.7.2: and Yahweh thy God shall deliver them up before thee, and thou shalt smite them, thou shalt devote them to destruction, thou shalt not solemnise with them a covenant neither shalt thou shew them favour;
texts.deu.7.3: neither shalt thou intermarry with them,—thy daughter, shalt thou not give unto his son, nor his daughter, shalt thou take for thy son;
texts.deu.7.4: for he will turn aside thy son from following me, and they will serve other gods,—so shall the anger of Yahweh kindle upon you, and he will destroy thee, speedily.
texts.deu.7.5: Verily, thus, shall ye do unto them: Their altars, shall ye tear down, And their pillars, shall ye break in pieces,—And their sacred stems, shall ye hew down, And their carved images, shall ye burn up in the fire.
texts.deu.7.6: For a holy people, art thou unto Yahweh thy God: of thee, hath Yahweh thy God, made choice, that thou shouldest become his people as a treasure, above all the peoples that are on the face of the ground:
texts.deu.7.7: not because ye were more in number than any of the peoples, did Yahweh become attached to you and make choice of you,—for, ye, were fewer than any of the peoples;
texts.deu.7.8: but because Yahweh loved you and because he would keep the oath which he sware unto your fathers, did Yahweh bring you forth with a firm hand,—and redeem thee out of the house of servants, out of the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
texts.deu.7.9: So then, thou must know that, Yahweh thy God, he, is God,—the faithful GOD, keeping his covenant and his lovingkindness with them that love him and keep his commandments, to a thousand generations
texts.deu.7.10: but requiting them who hate him unto his face to destroy them,—he will not be slack towards him that hateth him, unto his face, will he requite him.
texts.deu.7.11: So shalt thou keep the commandment and the statutes and the regulations, which I am commanding thee to-day, to do them.
texts.deu.7.12: Then shall it come to pass if ye will hearken unto these regulations, and keep and do them, then will Yahweh thy God keep with thee the covenant and the lovingkindness which he sware unto thy fathers;
texts.deu.7.13: and will love thee, and bless thee and multiply thee,—and bless the fruit of thy body and the fruit of thy ground thy corn and thy new wine and thine oil the young of thy kine and the ewes of thy flock, upon the soil which he swart unto thy fathers to give unto thee.
texts.deu.7.14: Blessed shalt thou be beyond all the peoples,—there shall not be in thee a barren male or female, nor among thy cattle;
texts.deu.7.15: and Yahweh, will turn away, from thee, all disease,—and as for all the sore sicknesses of Egypt which thou knowest, he will not lay them upon thee, but will put them upon all who hate thee;
texts.deu.7.16: and thou shalt devour all the peoples whom, Yahweh thy God, is delivering up unto thee, thine eye shall not look with pity upon them, neither shalt thou serve their gods, for a snare, would it be unto thee.
texts.deu.7.17: Although thou mightest say in thy heart: More in number, are these nations than I,—how can, I dispossess them?
texts.deu.7.18: thou must not be afraid of them,—thou must, remember, what Yahweh thy God did, unto Pharaoh and unto all Egypt:
texts.deu.7.19: the great provings which thine own eyes saw, and the signs and the wonders and the firm hand and the stretched-out arm, wherewith Yahweh thy God brought thee forth,—so, will Yahweh thy God do unto all the peoples, before whom thou art afraid.
texts.deu.7.20: Moreover also, the hornet, will Yahweh thy God send among them,—until they are destroyed who are left remaining, and who are hiding themselves from thy face.
texts.deu.7.21: Thou shalt not be affrighted at their presence,—for Yahweh thy God in thy midst is a Go great and to be revered.
texts.deu.7.22: So will Yahweh thy God, clear away these nations from before thee little by little,—thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the wild beast of the field should multiply ever thee.
texts.deu.7.23: But Yahweh thy God will deliver them up before thee,—and discomfit them with a great discomfiture, until they are destroyed;
texts.deu.7.24: and will deliver their kings into thy hand and thou shalt destroy their name, from under the heavens,—not a man shall stand before thee, until thou hast destroyed them.
texts.deu.7.25: The carved images of their gods, shalt thou consume with fire,—thou shalt not covet the silver and gold upon them to take unto thee, lest thou be ensnared thereby; for the abomination of Yahweh thy God, it is;
texts.deu.7.26: and thou shalt not bring an abomination into thy house, and so become devoted to destruction, like it, thou shalt, abhor, it, and thou shalt, loathe it, because a thing devoted to destruction, it is.
texts.deu.8.1: All the commandment which I am commanding thee to-day, shalt thou, observe, to do,—that ye may, live, and multiply, and enter in and possess the land, which Yahweh sware unto your fathers.
texts.deu.8.2: So then, thou shalt remember all the way in which Yahweh thy God caused thee to journey these forty years in the desert,—that he might humble thee to put thee to the proof to know what was in thy heart,—whether thou wouldest keep his commandments or not.
texts.deu.8.3: So he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna which thou hadst not known, neither had thy fathers known,—that he might lead thee to consider that not on bread alone, shall the son of earth live, but on whatsoever cometh from the bidding of Yahweh, shall the son of earth live.
texts.deu.8.4: Thy mantle, hath not fallen with age from off thee, and, thy foot, hath not become swollen,—these forty years.
texts.deu.8.5: Thou must consider, then with thy heart,—that as a man chasteneth his son, Yahweh thy God, hath been chastening thee.
texts.deu.8.6: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments of Yahweh thy God,—to walk in his ways and to revere him.
texts.deu.8.7: For, Yahweh thy God, is bringing thee into a good land; a land of ravines of water, of fountains and depths, coming forth in valley, and in mountain:
texts.deu.8.8: a land of wheat and barley, and vine and fig-tree, and pomegranate,—a land of olive oil, and honey:
texts.deu.8.9: a land wherein not in scarcity, shalt thou eat food, thou shalt lack nothing therein,—a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest hew copper.
texts.deu.8.10: So then thou shalt eat and be satisfied,—and bless Yahweh thy God, for the good land which he hath given unto thee.
texts.deu.8.11: Take heed to thyself, lest thou forget Yahweh thy God,—so as not to keep his commandments and his regulations and his statutes, which I am commanding thee to-day;
texts.deu.8.12: lest thou eat, and be satisfied,—and goodly houses, thou build and inhabit;
texts.deu.8.13: and thy herd and thy flock, increase, and silver and gold, increase unto thee,—and all that thou hast, increase;
texts.deu.8.14: and so thy heart be lifted up,—and thou forget Yahweh thy God, who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt out of the house of servants;
texts.deu.8.15: who caused thee to journey through the great and terrible desert, of fiery serpents and scorpions, and thirsty wastes where was no water,—who brought forth for thee water out of the flinty rock;
texts.deu.8.16: who fed thee with manna in the desert, which thy fathers had not known,—that he might humble thee, and that he might put thee to the proof, to do thee good in thy hereafter,
texts.deu.8.17: and lest thou shouldest say in thy heart,—Mine own strength and the might of mine own hand, have gotten me this wealth.
texts.deu.8.18: But thou shalt remember Yahweh thy God, that it was, he, who had been giving thee strength to get wealth,—that so he might establish his covenant which he sware to thy fathers (as at this day).
texts.deu.8.19: But it shall be if thou forget, Yahweh thy God, and go after ether gods, and serve them, and bow thyself down to them, I testify against you to-day, that ye shall perish:
texts.deu.8.20: like the nations which, Yahweh, is causing to perish from before you, so, shall ye perish, because ye would not hearken unto the voice of Yahweh your God.
texts.deu.9.1: Hear O Israel! thou art passing, to-day, over the Jordan, to go in to dispossess nations, greater and stronger than thou,—cities great and fortified into the heavens;
texts.deu.9.2: a people great and tall, the sons of Anakim,—whom, thou, knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the sons of Anak?
texts.deu.9.3: So then, thou must consider to-day, that Yahweh thy God, he it is that is passing over before thee as a consuming fire, he, will destroy them, and, he, will cause them to bow down before thee,—so shalt thou dispossess them, and destroy them speedily, as Yahweh hath spoken unto thee.
texts.deu.9.4: Do not speak in thy heart, when Yahweh thy God casteth them out from before thee saying, For mine own righteousness, hath Yahweh brought me in, to possess this land,—whereas it is for the lawlessness of these nations, that, Yahweh, is dispossessing them from before thee.
texts.deu.9.5: Not for thine own righteousness, nor for the uprightness of thine own heart, art thou going in to possess their land,—but for the lawlessness of these nations, is, Yahweh thy God driving them out from before thee, and that he may establish the word which Yahweh sware unto thy fathers, unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob.
texts.deu.9.6: So then, thou must consider that, not for thine own righteousness, is Yahweh thy God giving unto thee this good land to possess it,—for a stiff-necked people, thou art.
texts.deu.9.7: Remember—do not forget, how thou didst provoke Yahweh thy God, in the desert,—yea from the day when thou camest forth out of the and of Egypt until ye entered as far as this place, have ye been quarrelling, with Yahweh.
texts.deu.9.8: Even in Horeb, ye provoked Yahweh to wrath,—so that Yahweh showed himself angry with you to destroy you.
texts.deu.9.9: When I went up into the mountain to receive the tables of stone—the tables of the covenant, which Yahweh had solemnised with you, then abode I in the mountain forty days and forty nights, food, did I not, eat, and water, did I not drink.
texts.deu.9.10: Then did Yahweh deliver unto me the two tables of stone, written with the finger of God,—and [there was] upon them, according to all the words which Yahweh had spoken with you in the mountain out of the midst of the fire in the day of the convocation.
texts.deu.9.11: So then it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Yahweh gave unto me the two tables of stone the tables of the covenant.
texts.deu.9.12: Then said Yahweh unto me—Up! get down quickly out of this mountain, for thy people whom thou hast brought forth out of Egypt, have broken faith,—they have turned aside quickly, out of the way which I commanded them,—they have made them a molten image.
texts.deu.9.13: And Yahweh spake unto me saying,—I have looked on this people, and lo! a stiff-necked people, it is.
texts.deu.9.14: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and wipe out their name from under the heavens,—and make thee into a nation stronger and more in number than they.
texts.deu.9.15: So I turned, and came down out of the mountain, now the mountain was burning with fire,—and the two tables of the covenant were upon my two hands.
texts.deu.9.16: Then looked I, and lo! ye had sinned against Yahweh your God, ye had made you a molten calf,—ye had turned aside quickly, out of the way which Yahweh had commanded you.
texts.deu.9.17: So I seized the two tables, and cast them from off my two hands,—and brake them in pieces before your eyes.
texts.deu.9.18: Then lay I prostrate before Yahweh as at the first, forty days and forty nights, food, did I not eat, and water, did I not drink,—because of all your sin which ye had sinned, in doing the thing that was wicked, in the eyes of Yahweh. to provoke him to anger.
texts.deu.9.19: For I shrank with fear from the face of the anger and the hot displeasure, wherewith Yahweh was provoked against you to destroy you,—but Yahweh hearkened unto me, even at that time.
texts.deu.9.20: And with Aaron, did Yahweh show himself exceedingly angry, to destroy him,—so I prostrated myself, even in behalf of Aaron at that time.
texts.deu.9.21: And your sin which ye had made even the calf, took I and burned it up with fire, and pounded it very small, until it was fine as dust,—then cast I the dust thereof into the torrent that descended out of the mountain.
texts.deu.9.22: Also, at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hataavah, a cause of provocation, became ye unto Yahweh.
texts.deu.9.23: Also when Yahweh sent you out of Kadesh-barnea saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given unto you then quarreled ye with the bidding of Yahweh your God, and trusted him not, neither hearkened unto his voice.
texts.deu.9.24: Ye have been quarrelling, with Yahweh,—from the day that I first knew you.
texts.deu.9.25: Thus, then lay I prostrate before Yahweh, the forty days and the forty nights that I did lie prostrate,—because Yahweh spake of destroying you.
texts.deu.9.26: Therefore I prostrated myself unto Yahweh and said, My Lord Yahweh! Do not destroy thy people even thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed in thy greatness,—which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a firm hand.
texts.deu.9.27: Have remembrance of thy servants, of Abraham, of Isaac and of Jacob,—do not regard the obduracy of this people, or their lawlessness or their sin:
texts.deu.9.28: lest the land out of which thou hast brought us forth say, Because Yahweh was not able to bring them into the land of which he had spoken to them,—and because he hated them, took he them forth to put them to death in the desert.
texts.deu.9.29: Yet, they, are thy people and thine inheritance,—whom thou hast brought forth with thy great strength, and with thy stretched-out arm.
texts.deu.10.1: At that time, said Yahweh unto me—Cut thee out two tables of stone like the first, and come up unto me into the mountain,—and make thee an ark of wood;
texts.deu.10.2: that I may write, upon the tables, the words which were on the first tables which thou brakest in pieces,—then shalt thou put them in the ark.
texts.deu.10.3: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut out two tables of stone like the first,—and went up the mountain, having the two tables in my hand.
texts.deu.10.4: And he wrote upon the tables according to the first writing—the ten words, which Yahweh had spoken unto you in the mountain, out of the midst of the fire in the day of the convocation,—and Yahweh delivered them unto me.
texts.deu.10.5: Then turned I, and came down out of the mountain, and put the tables in the ark which I had made,—and they have remained there, as Yahweh commanded me.
texts.deu.10.6: And, the sons of Israel, set forward out of Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah,—there, died Aaron and was buried there, and Eleazar his son became priest in his stead.
texts.deu.10.7: From thence, set they forward unto the Gudgodah,—and from the Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of torrents of water.
texts.deu.10.8: At that time, did Yahweh separate the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Yahweh,—to stand before Yahweh to wait upon him and to bless in his name (until this day).
texts.deu.10.9: For this cause, hath Levi neither portion nor inheritance with his brethren,—Yahweh, is his inheritance, as Yahweh thy God spake unto him.
texts.deu.10.10: But, I, stayed in the mountain according to the former days, forty days and forty nights,—and Yahweh hearkened unto me at that time also, Yahweh was not willing, to destroy thee.
texts.deu.10.11: So then Yahweh said unto me, Up with thee—to break away onward, before the people,—that they may enter in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers, to give unto them.
texts.deu.10.12: Now, therefore, O Israel, what is, Yahweh thy God, asking of thee,—but to revere Yahweh thy God to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahweh thy God, with all thy heart, and with all thy soul:
texts.deu.10.13: to keep the commandments of Yahweh and his statutes, which I am commanding thee to-day,—for thy good?
texts.deu.10.14: Lo! unto Yahweh thy God, belong the heavens even the highest heavens,—the earth, with all that is therein.
texts.deu.10.15: Only unto thy fathers, Yahweh became attached so as to love them,—therefore made he choice of their seed after them—of you—out of all the peoples, (as at this day).
texts.deu.10.16: Therefore must ye circumcise the foreskin of your hearts,—and your necks, must ye stiffen no more.
texts.deu.10.17: For as touching Yahweh your God, he, is God of gods, and Lord of lords; the great the mighty, and the fearful GOD, who respecteth not persons, nor accepteth a bribe;
texts.deu.10.18: executing the vindication of the orphan and the widow,—and loving a sojourner, giving him food and raiment.
texts.deu.10.19: Therefore shall ye love the sojourner,—for sojourners, became ye in the land of Egypt.
texts.deu.10.20: Yahweh thy God, shalt thou revere, Him, shalt thou serve,—And unto him, shalt thou cleave, And in his name, shalt thou swear.
texts.deu.10.21: He, is thy song of praise, And, he, thy God,—who hath done with thee these great and fearful things, which thine own eyes have seen.
texts.deu.10.22: As seventy souls, went thy fathers down to Egypt,—and, now, Yahweh thy God hath made thee like the stars of the heavens for multitude.
texts.deu.11.1: Therefore shalt thou love Yahweh thy God and keep his observance and his statutes and his regulations and his commandments all the days.
texts.deu.11.2: And ye must know to-day, (for not with your sons [do I speak] who know not, neither have they seen) the discipline of Yahweh your God,—his greatness, his firm hand, and his stretched-out arm;
texts.deu.11.3: and his signs and his doings, which he did in the midst of Egypt,—unto Pharaoh king of Egypt and unto all his land;
texts.deu.11.4: and what he did unto the forces of Egypt—unto his horses and unto his chariots in that he caused the waters of the Red Sea to flow over their faces, when they were pursuing after you,—and so Yahweh destroyed them (unto this day);
texts.deu.11.5: and what he did unto you, in the desert,—until ye came in as far as this place;
texts.deu.11.6: and what he did to Dathan and to Abiram, sons of Eliab, son of Reuben, in that the earth opened wide her mouth, and swallowed-up them and their households and their tents,—and all the living things that attended them, in the midst of all Israel.
texts.deu.11.7: For yours, are the eyes that have seen every great deed of Yahweh,—which he hath done.
texts.deu.11.8: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandment which I am commanding thee, today,—that ye may be strong, and so enter and possess the land, whither ye are passing over to possess it;
texts.deu.11.9: and that ye may prolong your days upon the soil which Yahweh sware unto your fathers, to give unto them and unto their seed,—a land flowing with milk and honey.
texts.deu.11.10: For the land which thou art entering to, possess, not like the land of Egypt, it is, from whence ye came out,—where thou didst sow thy seed, and then water it with thy foot, like a garden of herbs;
texts.deu.11.11: but the land whereinto ye are passing over to, possess it, is a land of hills, and valleys,—which of the rain of the heavens, doth drink water:
texts.deu.11.12: a land which Yahweh thy God careth for,—continually are the eyes of Yahweh thy God upon it, from the beginning of the year, even unto the end of the year.
texts.deu.11.13: And it shall come to pass, if ye will hearken, unto my commandments, which, I am commanding you to-day,—to love Yahweh your God, and to serve him, with, all your heart, and with all your soul,
texts.deu.11.14: then [saith he] I will give the rain of your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain; so shalt thou gather in thy corn, and thy new wine and thine oil;
texts.deu.11.15: and I will give grass in thy field for thy cattle,—and thou shalt eat and be satisfied.
texts.deu.11.16: Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be befooled,—and ye turn aside and serve other gods, and bow down to them.
texts.deu.11.17: So would the anger of Yahweh kindle upon you and he would shut up the heavens, that there should be no rain, and the ground, would not yield her increase,—so should ye perish speedily, from off the good land, which Yahweh is giving unto you.
texts.deu.11.18: Therefore shall ye lay these my words upon your heart, and upon your soul,—and bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall serve as bands between your eyes;
texts.deu.11.19: and ye shall teach them unto your children by speaking of them,—when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down and when thou risest up;
texts.deu.11.20: and thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house and within thy gates:
texts.deu.11.21: that your days may multiply, and the days of your children, upon the soil which Yahweh sware unto your fathers, to give unto them,—like the days of the heavens upon the earth.
texts.deu.11.22: For if ye do, indeed keep, all this commandment which I am commanding you to do it,—to love Yahweh your God, to Walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him,
texts.deu.11.23: then will Yahweh dispossess all these nations, from before you,—and ye shall dispossess nations greater and stronger than ye:
texts.deu.11.24: every place whereon the sole of your foot shall tread yours, shall it be,—from the desert and the Lebanon from the river—the river Euphrates, even unto the hinder sea, shall be your boundary.
texts.deu.11.25: No man shall stand before you,—the dread of you and the fear of you, will Yahweh your God put forth over the face of all the land whereon ye shall tread, as he spake unto you.
texts.deu.11.26: See! I am setting before you to-day,—a blessing, and a curse:
texts.deu.11.27: the blessing, when ye shall hearken unto the commandments of Yahweh your God, which I am commanding you to-day;
texts.deu.11.28: and the curse if ye, shall not hearken unto the commandments of Yahweh your God, but shall turn aside out of the way which I am commanding you to-day,—to go after other gods which ye know not.
texts.deu.11.29: And it shall come to pass when Yahweh thy God shall bring thee into the land which thou art entering to possess, then shalt thou put the blessing, upon Mount Gerizim, and the curse, upon Mount Ebal.
texts.deu.11.30: Are, they, not over the Jordan on the way towards the entering in of the sun, in the land of the Canaanite who dwelleth in the plain over against Gilgal beside the Teacher’s Terebinths?
texts.deu.11.31: For ye are passing over the Jordan, to enter to possess the land which Yahweh your God, is giving unto you,—so shall ye possess it and dwell therein.
texts.deu.11.32: Therefore shall ye observe to do all the statutes and the regulations,—which I am setting before you to-day.
texts.deu.12.1: These are the statutes and the regulations which ye must observe to do, in the land which Yahweh the God of thy fathers hath given unto thee, to possess it,—all the days that ye are living upon the soil:
texts.deu.12.2: Ye must utterly destroy, all the places where the nations whom ye are dispossessing have served their gods,—Upon the high mountains And upon the hills, And under every green tree;
texts.deu.12.3: And ye must tear down their altars And break in pieces their pillars, And, their sacred stems, must ye consume with fire, And the carved images of their gods, must ye fell to the ground,—And destroy their name out of that place.
texts.deu.12.4: Ye must not do thus unto Yahweh your God;
texts.deu.12.5: but, unto the place which Yahweh your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there,—as his habitation, shall ye ask your way, and come in thither;
